name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: ONE . . . WEEK . . . AWAY . . .
body:
Dear Peter,

It’s only been a few days since Vice President Kamala Harris mocked Christians at one of her rallies, saying, "You guys are at the wrong rally," to two pro-life students who proclaimed, “Jesus is King!” . . .

And she’s already attacking Christians again!

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/wnGuBTqQcOQ4raBQ5zVUdg~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRpA_

In a recent MSNBC interview, the Vice President was asked what “religious exemptions” she would have in her late-term, abortion-on-demand agenda for pro-life Christians.

She scowled at the thought of even letting ONE baby live, and snarled:

“I don’t think we should be making concessions when we are talking about a fundamental freedom to make decisions about your own body.”

Peter, Kamala Harris has ZERO plans to allow you and me to opt-out of supporting abortion.

If given the chance, she WILL force every Christian in America to not only accept her extreme abortion agenda, but also pay for it with our taxpayer dollars and force doctors to commit abortions!

With the 2024 Elections only ONE WEEK AWAY, we need to make sure every Christian in America knows how radical Kamala Harris truly is!

That’s why Students for Life Action is running our “Vote Pro-Life First” Digital Campaign in overdrive right now –
including a hard-hitting commercial exposing Kamala’s abortion extremism that you can watch HERE
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Uyd13H_gkrRN1BYwo6wdwg~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRpA_
!

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/4jc-G-UCKfTJVpdaohsyxA~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRpA_

Peter, right now the most effective use of our resources is in the digital realm.

Buying ad space on websites, running ad campaigns on social media, and airing commercials on TV (like the one above) all produce instant results!

You see, we’ve found when voters hear what a Kamala Harris presidency would mean for preborn babies across the country, they’re horrified!

And when they learn how she wants to squash our freedoms of religion and speech under her heel in the name of killing babies, they want to stop her at all costs!

But here’s the kicker.

When these voters see our ads and commercials exposing Kamala Harris this close to the election, the result is a HUGE grassroots force that the Abortion Lobby couldn’t account for!

With your help, Students for Life Action is hoping to run our “Vote Pro-Life First” Digital Campaign at full steam through November 5th.

Any amount you can give will directly result in more “Pro-Life First” voters turning out on Election Day!

So, will you please consider chipping into our efforts as we approach election day by making your most generous contribution possible towards Students for Life Action’s “Vote Pro-Life First” Digital Campaign
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/r7v2n6QX-qpoPymxOnBrqw~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRpA_
?

Your generosity during this critical time will be a shot-in-the-arm for the Pro-Life Movement.

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

| | Election Day is one week away — we’ve made it to the final stretch of a historic election season. The Fair Fight team is closely monitoring turnout and polling data, and I’m doing my part to get out the vote for the Democrats up and down the ballot, but still it’s looking too close to call. The presidential election will come down to the voters in our battleground states, including right here in Georgia. **Our votes will make the difference for our futures and our democracy.** We saw record-breaking turnout on the first day of early voting, and Georgians continue to cast their ballots in waves ahead of November 5, because we know our rights are at stake — and that Republicans have no issue trying to bend rules to their will. **With early voting in Georgia ending soon, we’re running out of time to reach voters and mobilize turnout.[That’s why I’m asking if you’ll make your first gift to Fair Fight today to keep Georgia blue and keep voter suppression out of our elections?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96110944/508945219/1373839404?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20241029_f_EOM2_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWQyYzE1Yi01Mjk2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GyEQWqxugFKmjIiXvpMVUgTa1EQ8uD5Cca6RFGL-8eE=)** | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96110948/508945223/1373839404?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20241029_f_EOM2_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWQyYzE1Yi01Mjk2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GyEQWqxugFKmjIiXvpMVUgTa1EQ8uD5Cca6RFGL-8eE=)

If you needed further proof of how energized voters are this year, here’s a promising update from the Fair Fight team:

# Sharon Clahchischilliage Invites President Donald Trump to New Mexico
---
| “Hey Donald Trump,
Sharon Clahchischilliage here. I am a candidate running for U.S. Congress New Mexico District 3. This is an invitation to you to come visit us here in (NM) District 3.
I want you to meet the people who are experiencing the effects of a buffer zone around Chaco Canyon.
I want you to meet the people of Mora County who have been left homeless because they have not been compensated from a fire that occurred two years ago in Mora County.
I want you to experience the people, the ranchers, the farmers, who are experiencing land grabs in their area. I need for you to. come here and see what the government is doing to District 3.
You know what? District 3 is rich. We have the Permian Basin. We have the San Juan Basin. Which is a big concern to the global energy world. We fund 50% of the state budget.
So, consider this a very important invitation President Trump. I need your help. I need you to help me show the people that we care. I need you to help me show the people that we CAN do something for them.”

| Hi - It’s Eric.
**We have one week left until Election Day.**
I know that one week doesn’t seem like a lot of time, but it’s enough for you to still make a difference in this race.**In the meantime, here are a few things you should know:**
1. My opponent, Democrat Rep. Lisa Blunt Rochester, has been phoning it in since day one because she thinks she already owns this Senate seat. She’s skipped every debate, dodged public appearances, and ducked out on meetings with voters. She simply doesn’t show up. If this is how she acts as a candidate, how do you think she’ll behave as your Senator?

2. I care about getting results - not becoming a career politician. That’s why I’ve pledged to serve only one term - two at most if voters overwhelmingly support a second term.

3. As your next Senator, my top priorities will be cutting taxes and reducing inflation, utilize federal resources to crack down on violent crime, and restore trust in government. AND I’ll work with ANYONE willing to tackle these issues head-on!

**If you’ve been waiting to get involved in this election, now’s the time to step up! We desperately**[**need volunteers**](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=3edfd1e072&e=dbd1068b05)**and**[**donations**](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=ee901344d2&e=dbd1068b05)**to help us get across the finish line. You deserve better than what you’re getting right now in Washington. With one week left, now’s the time to help bring about the change our state so desperately needs!
Thanks, Eric

body:
John Avlon for Congress [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/111890/images/Avlon_CommonSenseforCongress_72ppi_2_color_blue.png]
Friends,
251 days ago, I decided to get in the arena and run for Congress.
Given the stakes of this election for our country and community, just talking about the fate of our democracy on TV felt civically lazy.
As a historian and the grandson of immigrants, I know that we cannot take our democracy for granted.
Running for Congress is the honor of a lifetime. I love listening and learning from people and honestly answering their questions about how we can reunite as a country and community.
One of the most common questions I get is - why? Why are you doing this? Why did you quit your job and take the leap?
I often think back to what I said 251 days ago when I started this journey:
“We need to build the broadest possible coalition to defend our democracy, defeat Donald Trump, and win back the House from his MAGA minions. I know that if we work together, we can flip this seat and finally solve problems for Long Island families.
I’m running for Congress because there’s too much at stake for the country and the community I love. We need to rebuild the middle class, protect women’s reproductive freedom, invest in our infrastructure, transportation and mitigate climate change.
And we can’t ignore the threat to our democracy that Donald Trump and his MAGA minions in Congress pose - including just recently blocking a bipartisan border security bill on Trump’s orders, all to appease their leader. They’re refusing to do their jobs – and that’s a firing offense.
We have to get past this poisonous hyper-partisanship. I believe in a different approach.
Our next member of Congress needs to work with all people of good faith, based on common sense and common facts to solve the common problems we face.”
Even with all the twists and turns of this campaign, I’m proud to say that’s what our campaign has always been about. I’m humbled to see just how many happy warriors we’ve been able to inspire and just how broad of a coalition we’ve been able to build.
251 days ago, I declared that if we work together, we really could flip this seat. Now, we’ve been highlighted as one of the most important battleground races in the country.
New York’s First District - with more registered Independents than nearly every district in America - is going to decide the balance of power in the House. And for it to go our way, all we have to do is vote:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon251days?refcode=1029 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon251days?refcode=1029]
That’s not something I take lightly. It’s why I remain grounded in the idea that we can work together with common sense to solve our common problems. It’s why this election is too big for teamism.
Thank you for being with me on this journey. Some of you have been with me a lot longer than 251 days, and some of you are just joining the team. I wouldn’t be here without each and every one of you.
This is it. The final push. My team knocked on some absurd number of doors this weekend (north of 18,000!) and called and texted over 100,000 people. We are leaving it all on the field. One more time before November 5th, can you pitch in to support our work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon251days?refcode=1029]
Please chip in today and let’s go win this thing >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon251days?refcode=1029]
This is going to be close. Multiple recent polls have our race running neck-and-neck. But if you’re seeing what we’re seeing - you know we are running up the middle and closing fast. The path to victory is in front of us. Now it’s time to run through the tape.
Thank you for fighting the good fight with me.
-John

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: End the chaos, build the future
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
We’re on the verge of something remarkable.
Imagine a future where the relentless churn of doom-filled headlines, political chaos, and division fades into memory.
Imagine a future where we leave behind the hatred, bigotry, and neighbor-against-neighbor strife that have fractured our communities.
What if, instead of clinging to anger, we turned the page to a chapter filled with unity, compassion, and real progress?
When we defeat Jim Jordan, we don’t just retire the most dangerous man in Congress. We plant a flag for all who believe in a brighter, kinder future—a vision of America that values every voice, embraces every neighbor, and protects every right.
We’ve come such a long way together and our momentum is unstoppable – help us finish what we started together by rushing a contribution right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241029_blue_momentum_link1]
Taking down Jim Jordan means making Ohio a force for positive change, shifting our state’s political landscape in a way that amplifies every vote on the ballot.
Think about it: a future where “we the people” really means everyone, where our leaders work for us, and where our government reflects the goodness of the people it serves.
This isn’t just about winning one seat; this is about changing the tide for the whole country.
When we flip OH-04, we boost the entire ticket, drawing up Democratic support in races from the presidency to the Senate.
This is how we build a nation that works for all of us—a movement of citizens ready to set a new course.
The important thing is we have the energy, enthusiasm, and infrastructure to do it!
But this future won’t create itself.
We’re nearly a week away, and every phone call, ad, and conversation we have could mean the difference not just in our race but for races up and down the ticket.
We’ve got Jordan and the ULTRA-MAGA movement right where we want him, but we need to keep the momentum.
Will you chip in today to make this future a reality? With your support, we’ll put an end to Jordan’s chaos and take a giant step toward that vision of America we all know is possible. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241029_blue_momentum_link2]
Thank you for standing with us and with hope.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

name: Kari Lake
subject: I've made a lot of sacrifices.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SCOTT FOR AMERICA
body:
There is not much time left to save this country. I’m willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

**[Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=aba43fe0534a43cc9671ff883c8adac0&_e=9WgFcGgv4R_PX_Z_NCuZPoncFoop4YxrWhXOiKV9Zh-vGVOaxCMgR2OvZB2vLlcs36lXAFTgxdNwGOQ1gY-0tQT24H815hAWOArFlFJj0YPjkccPv6kW4o0wMhyD0tt_G-JiovwTwQrBVsxCmgaVu9teHqF1pIfbV8lZeOGknDTD-v9SG_lZU0_U4XOaSQIbk15TqQLGKGF6O7YAjUfv2Z7kNzwo4XuRh6SebQ4neIJwQ_y9KSwYMRGKlu_WTkBWBmlbYsCZ_AEqDw9pLJOT9mtFOoz7x-okp7Pj7N0rvim8BCBuNXRDtpHSCVG7cLhIXhnXojR4W1zuiHQo5yTeDuOXnixY_x2oqOUTXBPaBc6ChK6Q0ZsnhyvO0xllQ-w5VQ1JOhqKUeqH8HM1kG4k4Ok9ellqCQh8u6dbhfvCCTE3c2PlhxSdkzGlV3PKk15q "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?")**

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you.

**There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. **

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

**I miss my family.** There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

**I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing.** Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

**I miss not having to send these emails.** Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help.

**I miss my alone time!** I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

**[My staff has shared these links with me, which you can click to donate. Angus is a critical partner of mine in the U.S. Senate, and we can’t afford to lose his thoughtful, compassionate, bipartisan approach to policy making. He’s running for reelection in Maine and I’d like to ask you to support his campaign by splitting a $20 contribution between our campaigns. **[Can you chip in today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96113140/508985690/650951518?amount=20&refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241029_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzgyN2U3Yy01ZTk2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q6ZPD8uq_rsovdH2d9kEM5VuuKy9nG9Csr-e7zbcygk=)** **[There’s just too much on the line — from reproductive rights to access to the ballot box — to risk losing Angus and letting Republicans take back the Senate majority. Can you chip in today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96113141/508985691/650951518?amount=20&refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241029_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzgyN2U3Yy01ZTk2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q6ZPD8uq_rsovdH2d9kEM5VuuKy9nG9Csr-e7zbcygk=)** \---------- Forwarded message --------- [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96113142/508985692/650951518?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241029_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzgyN2U3Yy01ZTk2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q6ZPD8uq_rsovdH2d9kEM5VuuKy9nG9Csr-e7zbcygk=) Blueberry bread is important here in my Washington D.C. office and I’ll explain why. [**But first, with only 7 days until the most important election of our lifetime, can you chip in $10 towards my campaign and my colleague Mazie?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96113143/508985693/650951518?amount=10&refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241029_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzgyN2U3Yy01ZTk2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q6ZPD8uq_rsovdH2d9kEM5VuuKy9nG9Csr-e7zbcygk=) At 9 AM on just about every Wednesday when the Senate is in session, we serve coffee and the best blueberry bread you could imagine to any and all Maine people who are visiting the Capitol. We even have a map of Maine in the office with pins for each hometown because people come from all over for blueberry bread Wednesdays! People visit D.C. for all kinds of reasons – from conferences to sightseeing – but no matter why they’re visiting I’m happy to provide them with a little taste of Maine hundreds of miles from home. And the best part? Getting to chat with fellow Maine people and hear their stories. We're living in divisive times, Peter. Now more than ever we need opportunities like this to bring us together. Peter, tomorrow begins early voting in Oklahoma. If you aren’t sure where early voting happens in your county, [you can find out here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=wM4juC3s27v2X_v1YR_CkJQV7jg8laevmHXL9LvpItYPgPRPFIArNzpc8T9ZT3Pb&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_early_voting_starts_tomorrow&n=2). Early voting is available Wednesday through Saturday with Election Day voting on Tuesday November 5th. You’ve probably heard plenty about the Presidential Election, but you might not have heard as much about the other items on the ballot. One of the most impactful votes you will cast is on the THREE Supreme Court judges on the ballot for retention. The voters in Oklahoma are being asked “should these judges be retained on the Oklahoma Supreme Court?” And the answer is NO, they should not be retained! All three judges are very liberal [(check out the score card made by OCPA scoring their liberal records)](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=R0gp0cTD5kYBAQC5bVnB3XVO9E9Tcb5I5YUIqFW6P11j1IaEUYnjuB5z73zAHt1w&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_early_voting_starts_tomorrow&n=3), and they were all appointed by Democrat Governors. They’ve constantly legislated from the bench with their decisions in order to force their liberal agenda on the people of Oklahoma. For more information on these judges & the other judges on the ballot please visit [OKGOP.com/judges/](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaOEva1Jz4u7JgJ_UBwFRQd8&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_early_voting_starts_tomorrow&n=4). Nearly four years ago, Donald Trump stood where I did tonight.
He sent an armed mob to the United States Capitol to overturn the will of the people in an election he knew he lost. And while he sat in the Oval Office watching the violence unfold on television, he responded with two words:
_“So what?”_
**That is who Donald Trump is. That is who is asking for another four years in the Oval Office.** An unstable 78-year-old man who is obsessed with revenge, consumed with grievance, and out for unchecked power.
Unlike Donald Trump, I pledge to be a President for all Americans. To always put country above party and above self. Because I love this country with all my heart and I believe in its promise because I have lived it.
_I saw how hard my mother worked to give her daughters the same chances this country gave her._
_I was blessed to have family who instilled in me the values of community, compassion, and faith that have always defined our nation at our best._
_I’ve spent my life fighting for people who have been overlooked, but still believe that in this country we should all be equal in the eyes of the law._
**I believe in the promise of America._I see it in all of you._**
**But to fulfill that promise, we must win on November 5.**

clean_body: We are ready to turn the page and write the next chapter in the most extraordinary story ever told. | | | As I said tonight at the Ellipse in Washington, D.C., I know that many of you have already cast your ballots. But many others are still considering who to vote for -- or whether to vote at all. In these final seven days, we must make the choice and stakes in this election clear to every voter. Especially those who are undecided. | | Nearly four years ago, Donald Trump stood where I did tonight. He sent an armed mob to the United States Capitol to overturn the will of the people in an election he knew he lost. And while he sat in the Oval Office watching the violence unfold on television, he responded with two words: “So what?” That is who Donald Trump is. That is who is asking for another four years in the Oval Office. An unstable 78-year-old man who is obsessed with revenge, consumed with grievance, and out for unchecked power. Unlike Donald Trump, I pledge to be a President for all Americans. To always put country above party and above self. Because I love this country with all my heart and I believe in its promise because I have lived it. I saw how hard my mother worked to give her daughters the same chances this country gave her. I was blessed to have family who instilled in me the values of community, compassion, and faith that have always defined our nation at our best. I’ve spent my life fighting for people who have been overlooked, but still believe that in this country we should all be equal in the eyes of the law. I believe in the promise of America.I see it in all of you. But to fulfill that promise, we must win on November 5. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | In less than 90 days, either Donald Trump or I will be in the Oval Office. With your support, we will turn the page one week from today. Let us start writing the next great chapter in the most extraordinary story ever told. Thank you and take care, Kamala Kamala Harris Vice President of the United States | | | |

# Who Will Fight for Your Healthcare?
---
|
Peter,
**The stakes couldn’t be higher.**

Patti Hewitt is **fighting to protect your healthcare, expand Medicaid, reduce prescription costs, and increase rural hospitals.** Meanwhile, Buddy Carter is**working to dismantle the Affordable Care Act** and **prioritize corporate interests over the needs of our families.**

**We can’t afford to lose this fight.**

With early voting coming to an end, we need your help to ensure voters in Coastal Georgia choose Patti and flip this seat blue. The Kamala Harris vs. Donald Trump election is rallying enthusiasm— _**but we must ensure that excitement translates into down-ballot votes**_ for leaders like Patti Hewitt. Here’s how you can help, Peter:
* [**Donate $20.24**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=1586cde91a&e=0f456155ff) to fund more outreach during this critical voting period.
* [**Donate $50**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=46d35c084a&e=0f456155ff) to help us cover advertising costs and reach every undecided voter.
* [**Donate $100**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=7388ca4987&e=0f456155ff) to provide the marketing resources needed for last-minute.

**Get Out The Vote efforts.**

Every dollar counts, Peter. Your contribution ensures Patti has the support to bring real change to our healthcare system and fight for _**YOU**_ in Washington.
Click here to donate and make your voice heard!
Together, we can elect leaders who care about people, not corporations. Thank you, Peter, for standing with us in this critical moment!

# _**Your YDA October Newsletter**_
---
_**Special Message from Young Democrats of America President Quentin Wathum-Ocama**_
---
Young Dems—this is it.

One week out from one of the most important elections of our lives, and it's time to go all in. This isn't just about politics; it's about defending our democracy and building a future that reflects all of us. Every single thing we do in these next seven days matters, whether it's casting our ballots, helping friends make their voting plans, or knocking on every door we can find.

**This is our moment to fight for the America we believe in — one where everyone has a fair shot, where rights are protected, and where our government serves the people**. So let's bring the energy, the grit, and the belief that, together, we can make it happen.

**One week left, Young Dems. Let's get it done.

** In Solidarity,
---
|
---
Quentin Wathum-Ocama
President, Young Democrats of America

Donald Trump’s campaign scapegoats and villainizes Puerto Rico because their over 3 million disenfranchised American citizens aren’t able to vote against him. He has nothing to offer voters other than fear of their fellow Americans; that is not democracy—it’s demagoguery.

Making a difference is why Lucas Mooney stays motivated when knocking door-to-door.

Mooney, a sophomore studying political science and a member of Young Democrats at ASU, spent Sept. 21, 2024, canvassing alongside other members of the organization for local representatives.

The Arizona Democrats held a canvassing launch this September, themed "Hispanic Heritage Month and Education," for Legislative District 9, which includes neighborhoods in West Mesa and part of Tempe. The event had 30 volunteers who knocked on about 1,000 doors throughout the day.

But campaigns have to get them to turn out.
---
On the ground in Nevada, the Democratic Party is working to mobilize voters on college campuses and in young professional spaces. In conversations, they’re emphasizing abortion rights — a popular issue among Nevadans broadly — and down-payment assistance. And they’re trying to improve voter education on Biden initiatives that appeal to younger voters, including climate investments and efforts to cancel student loans. Those events can be happy hours, parties or putting together abortion aftercare kits, in the case of one Young Democrat event last December.

“People think of Young Dems, and, at least in my experience, really thought that it was people sitting together and kind of just listening to panels,” said Maria Nieto Orta, the president of Young Democrats of Nevada. “Being part of the leadership group, to do these nontraditional, exciting events was really huge for me.”

**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.
We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.**
**Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. ****I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign in November._**
[**That's why I'm asking you to chip in just $10 — about the cost of a dozen doughnuts — to send me to the Senate. A dedicated Washington State Senator, Emily has fought for policies that uplift all of us, from protecting affordable healthcare to supporting public schools. She understands the challenges facing our community and has the experience to address them head-on in Congress. She is the best choice to represent Washington's 6th district on a national level. # Republican turnout is low in Eastern Washington
---
| Across the USA there has been a big push to encourage Republicans to vote early. Nationally, the message has gotten through and in many key states Republican voters are ahead of Democrats in early voting.
Unfortunately, we are not seeing the same trends here in Eastern Washington. A greater percentage of both high propensity and low propensity Democrat voters have turned ballots in - as compared to the Republican voters in the 5th Congressional District.
We need to do better!
It is not public record HOW you vote but it is public record IF you vote. Both parties spend an immense amount of money identifying their likely voters. Each day, “match-backs” are calculated that compare the turnout of each party.
Republicans in Eastern Washington are lagging. Please help us out!
IT IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT THAT YOU TURN YOUR BALLOTS IN AS SOON AS POSSIBLE! Also, please ask your friends and family to turn in their ballots TODAY.
Delaying returning your ballot FORCES US TO SPEND MORE to chase ballots, and on “Get Out The Vote” efforts like robo-calls and texting.
Given the situation, we will likely need to spend an extra $21,000 to remind likely Republicans who are sitting on their ballots THAT THEY NEED TO VOTE!
So much is at stake in this election. Turnout will determine a number of key races. An extreme, far left agenda will be imposed on all of us if the liberals control every elected position from top to bottom. The open border will continue, religious freedom will be eroded, and prices will skyrocket – not to mention that taxes will go up, again.
Please vote today - and if you can help us raise the resources necessary to fund the needed Get Out The Vote efforts - please consider a $10, $25 or $50 donation.

Thank you,Michael

subject: Last Call—7 Days to Win, and We Need You Now!
body:
Peter,**This is it.** We're in the final week before Election Day next Tuesday, and the countdown is on. We are nationally on the map to flip the 10th District - our chance of winning increases daily - and just this week, The Hill has our Partisan Voter Index Score at D+3 - that's the tightest point differential in years! We are incredibly close to making this happen. **This Thursday marks the last fundraising deadline before we cross the finish line, and we 're just $5,336.18 short of our final goal.** With only days left, every single contribution matters more than ever. [DONATE $25 TO HELP TODAY](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-r/) Your support in this critical stretch will fuel the essentials--chasing ballots, knocking on doors, placing signs at polling places, and reaching undecided voters across the District through digital media ads exposing Brad Schneider for the ineffective, partisan lame-duck representative that he is. **[Every action we take will bring us one step closer to victory, but we need your help to make it happen.](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-y/)** Here's how you can help today:**Donate**
If you've already voted or mailed in your ballot, help us reach your neighbors. Even a $25 donation could help expand our reach and ensure undecided voters hear our message. [MAKE A DONATION HERE](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-j/) **Vote Early **
**If you haven 't voted yet, find your nearest early voting site and cast your vote as soon as possible!** Each day, voters who cast their ballots are removed from the lists we use to allocate resources. Early voting means we can focus our time and budget efficiently on those who still need encouragement. Here's how to make sure your vote counts:
* You can vote early **in person** in your county at one of the locations listed on the graphics below.
* If needed, **request a mail-in/absentee ballot by this Thursday, October 31** using the button below.
📬 **PRO TIP :** Your voted ballot must be hand delivered to the County Clerk's office by 7pm on Election Day, or it may be returned via mail with a postmark no later than Election Day and received at the Lake County Clerk's office no later than 14 days after Election Day!

[MAIL IN BALLOT APPLICATION](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-t/) [LAKE COUNTY VOTER SERVICES](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-i/) [MCHENRY COUNTY VOTER SERVICES](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-d/) [COOK COUNTY VOTER SERVICES](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-h/) Your vote and support are invaluable as we fight for the future of our District and our nation. **Your family 's finances, our community's safety, and our individual freedoms are at stake, and your contribution will make a difference.**Also, mark your calendars and join us at Austin's on Election Night! We'd love to watch the results come in with you. Thank you, as always, for standing with us. _Julia_ Team Carris [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-k/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-u/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-o/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-m/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-fb-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-c/) [ Tweet ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-tw-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-q/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-li-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-a/) [ Forward ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-tlidtddjku-FE53F914-stlltjd-l-f) | [Unsubscribe](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-u-stlltjd-tlidtddjku-z/)

subject: Cruz's Election Denialism
body:

---

| | | | **Ted Cruz: Election Denier**
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v954x-fza7fd-kyd76rh3/)
---
| | | | We all saw with our own eyes what happened after the 2020 election: Ted Cruz cheered on the mob on January 6, led the objection to the election results certification, and then hid in a supply closet. **And spoiler alert:** He's ready to do it again. **We can’t let him. This November is our chance to finally hold him accountable by kicking him out of the Senate for good.** **Polls currently show him and Colin Allred TIED in Texas, but this is shaping up to be the most expensive race in the country.****So please, will you chip in $100, $50, $10, or whatever to Colin’s campaign and to help Colin defeat Ted Cruz and bring real, pro-democracy leadership to Texas?**
---
| [Donate to DEFEAT CRUZ!](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v954x-fza7fe-kyd76rh4/)
---
Ted Cruz has proven time and again to be the single most divisive politician in Washington. From leading the charge on the 2012 government shutdown to ushering in an era of extreme hyper-partisanship and pitting Americans against each other with dangerous, extremist rhetoric. **_Ted isn't just Texans' problem – he's ALL AMERICANS’ problem._** Ted Cruz's refusal to commit to accepting election results is _exactly_ the kind of rhetoric that led to January 6, and another six years of him in the Senate is a danger our democracy simply can’t afford. As a former voting rights lawyer, Colin knows firsthand how critical it is that we all remain committed to protecting our democracy and ensuring that something like January 6 never happens again. Texans deserve a leader who respects our democracy – and Colin will unequivocally accept the results of this election. **If you agree that Ted Cruz's extreme, anti-democracy rhetoric needs to go, please chip in now to Colin and No Dem Left Behind to help us defeat him.**

## Venezuelan Gang Members Arrested
Three men affiliated with the Venezuelan Tren de Aragua street gang were [arrested in Colorado and New Mexico](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOtCAUBeCnwQ5z4TI6FhR_Yzd_u6W5Ao5kUQywg_P2G6ff7hQn30nO12N6kA9-f_6nzelyLnGSIBUXwBEmSz68J9VYPYMdROO06BHkXeENm1X3aIYO-342Zu7uC8ydVFIJZW4k5mFZGq8vTACCAAkwtIRoLaEggTdjwTAFzvoSU1tWV9xJeQnv-HKpNXFrgl5LOTLDf0yOTI611naJp9pdzVeByfGKTI7f3u50HH5_8u0nWZf4HlNZ-YfklJLLJXMTQ0xkI99d5Zs7vYlN0vaoPgSfu54peG7kw2e8_PnGS8vfAAAA___sRmSJ) for the kidnapping and murder of North Texas resident Nilzult Petit. A fourth suspect remains at large. Petit, 33, was kidnapped and murdered in August after a payment dispute regarding a [multi-state ATM theft scheme](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGuozAQheGnMd0g2wMkFC62ocu2WyLjGcCSsSPbCck-_VXS3_pIn47-f7f5Zn3wcftrDzb1taZZS92BkoByJuvDe-4aMoukUTVs1AWlvnbYY7Mb1-Ol64nJOce4jiMrt-C1X_vVyWXgxpsPpiRKJbWUY2sRiSwqq7B3JJ3oJJOvKbd158ovW9bwTk_OrUtHE8xe670I_CP0JPR0nmcbF0fr-ZmFniKfRegpJGeD0NPBEWzOXCoTrClDTLnu8HXheGTiDMV6gppgYfARnhz5_4ODjbDZuME9Be8Yin0LPeFw1QOi0FOTDd1PH4Ivw0V0cjusD9-L9ddmT6N_AgAA__9Pc3Bx). The suspects also kidnapped two young children, later abandoning them along an I-35E service road after shooting Petit. Authorities arrested Carlos Luis Zambrano Bolivar, 25, and Jhonata Nahin Toro Gonzalez, 22, in Aurora, Colorado. Ehiker Alexander Morales Mendoza, 38, was arrested in Las Cruces, New Mexico. A fourth suspect, 29-year-old Jhonny Jesus Martinez Serrano, [has yet to be captured](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2PszAQhH-N6YzWXj5C4eJt6PK2V6LF3oB1xiDbCcn9-lPSXzujZzR6vq7TlXzwcflPG5vyvO2TBt1IBRJhcuTDa2oqZ2Zwg6rYqB5BXxpssVqN7VEN1kHf9tY1pFps-7mbaeiQL13XV968xxQgKNAAQ02IzhEqUthaB1Y0wM6XPdVl5cJPyrfw2h-cartvVTBrKUcW-E_oUejxPM_azjnymd-90OMHEXp8R0KPKPM9H2xLlsHHb3bywZF_7hwoylwSc5ELxUXGPZVVfmhp6fCFgtzuyXESeqySccfpQ_C560UDy0Y-fA6VPw09jP4NAAD__6lJass).
## Early Voting Update
More than six million Texans [have already voted](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGTgyAUBOBfAx3O40GiFhTX2OXaKx2EZ2SCkkMS9d_fmP7qb2Z3dn9u_c2GGJb7t53JlH1MPQJqIUEo6L0N8eg192YA30pORtYKsNHqovhkPA41uWasUeLQNK0bNciLvg44Smhrz4M5wyQokIAAbWWV8t4qaaW6OA-OaSAfSspVmajQbtcxHulNuXJp5tFMpTxXpr4Ydgy7bduqx26XExl2C20rw-5IryxicjYKiuRKSIuYfk9Pb5oHyuKzqLzykl5FlGzdgzLDjmfjn1uIMazXmmm4zzbET3H594m3wb8AAAD__5nkYOw) ahead of Election Day on Nov. 5, amounting to a 33% turnout rate of the state’s 18.6 million registered voters. In-person voting has exceeded the daily totals seen in 2020, when apprehension about COVID-19 kept many people home, while [mail-in voting is down](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2uqzAQhJ8GukW2F_JTuEhDc5XbnnRogzdhJWNHtgnh7Y9If5rdGY30aTQ_1-FK4iU8_9PMtnwecTDKtKAVoBocid-Gtnb2rtxZ12z1EZU5tdhhPVnNBhWOozm01N3RuMPROdKMZ4Wnjk612B2mFSqtjFLnhhCdI9SksRudGqtWsZMSU1MmLvyh_PBbfHNqxjjX3k6lvHKFl8r0lenXdW3mHPasMj0HWHJl-sDr_l7RS5Fxl18QMCW_wTsWTlCWFOJSIFFhkAwurgFyhAclmDgxZFinDba4wG6KeA-ZWcITfNyPBN7JlOBy0fl2-yd1su61iveSD8eqVc-ZxH9rlz93fFvzGwAA__-Fnned). By the time voting wrapped up in 2020, 66.73% of the state’s 16.96 million registered voters participated in the presidential election, while 59.39% participated in 2016.
## The Most Livable Cities In Texas
An analysis of 139 U.S. metropolitan areas by RentCafe, an apartment listing website, shows [which Texas cities are the most “livable,”](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOwjAQRL_G6Ryt1ybgwsU16bj2ymhjL2R1DkaxReDvT9BfM81o3kjv5zydSbLcrt-0cmjPS5kQ0GkD2sKUSPJrcl0KMyRvOg7maAFPzh5stwQ3-MGyc4YQHQzGRxe9P_HsZzyR507CG2bAggEE8D1ZmxJZQ8YeYoKoHHCSVra-Ldz4SfWSX-XBWx_L2uWwtHavyn4pHBWO-773v62u71LheOO9KhzbwpU1baw_AL2W2nRmeqc8aM6sozThqulG-VWl6rqUz7TbQrrvkrPU4agcXFeS_Llu_7p4BPwLAAD__2AKYnE) ranked by metrics such as cost of living, commute times, and accessibility to healthcare providers. Dallas (No. 72), Killeen (No. 106), and Austin (No. 109) [led the way](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAUhH-N2Yye_UiAwUMXtnTtiB74EayaOLKfIPn3Fe3c7fTd6XS6r9t4oxDD4_5JGzt5LWm0YBttQCOMnkJ8j03l3QS-NxU70yLYrsELVqvrZm57NG1vFk_kr4ATYNMvxnSTwa6vgjvLDCAYsAB9TYjeExoyeJk9zKoB9kFSrmVl4ReVJb7Tzrme01ZFt4o8i8IPZQdlh-M46swPmWnhM6DsMMV0V3Y4KUW9Uf5mUXb4E7o86FnWJOVEqYiOYacpst5YctKUmU6rys4_jxBjKNdWNXDfKMTfBfLvJbuzPwEAAP__PD1ktQ), each boasting a cost of living below the national average. All three have low poverty rates, and Dallas and Killeen have the highest concentration of healthcare providers in the state. Unsurprisingly, nearly 50% of residents in Dallas and Austin have long commutes.

| MassGOP Confident in November 5th Elections as Candidates Gear Up for Victory
---
---
| The MassGOP is excited for the November 5th elections, confident that our candidates are poised to gain seats in the legislature. The Party has worked tirelessly, raising funds, supporting candidates on the campaign trail, and laying a clear path to victory by spotlighting critical issues neglected by the Democratic supermajority.
In a show of strength and unity, top leaders have stepped forward to support candidates across Massachusetts. Thanks to the generous contributions of former Governor Charlie Baker, former Lieutenant Governor Karyn Polito, former secretary of Housing and Economic Development Mike Kennealy, Senate Minority Leader Bruce Tarr, and House Minority Leader Brad Jones, the MassGOP has raised a remarkable $200,000 in October, fueling our candidates throughout this election cycle.
Our dedicated team has met with candidates weekly to discuss strategy, resource allocation, and messaging, ensuring they are well-positioned for success. So far, The Party has provided over $200,000 in direct mail support, $23,000 in text messaging for more than 25 candidates, an additional $10,000 in digital advertising, approximately $9,000 in Facebook ads to support candidates--reaching over 900,000 impressions in targeted districts--and $300,000 in coordinated mail. This marks the largest financial investment in legislative races by the MassGOP in the past five years, underscoring our commitment to challenging the Democratic supermajority's hold on the Massachusetts legislature. For the first time in the party's history, we have been engaging with the Secretary of State's office to access early voting data, and targeting those voters through a robust digital and mail strategy, broadening our reach and impact.
Under the Democratic supermajority, Massachusetts faces a worsening migrant crisis, with taxpayer spending surpassing $1 billion this fiscal year alone, threatening essential services and straining our schools. Affordability is at an all-time low as residents contend with high taxes, burdensome regulations, and a hostile business climate that drives away families and businesses, stagnating wages. Massachusetts Republicans are committed to amending the right-to-shelter law to control the migrant influx, restoring affordability, and promoting a transparent government free from backdoor deals. Our candidates stand ready to bring practical solutions that will restore affordability, openness, and accountability to the Commonwealth.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale commented on the upcoming election, stating, "With six days left in the campaign, we are more confident than ever in our chances to gain seats in the legislature. The party has put in the hard work--raising funds, implementing a strategic, cutting-edge approach, and positioning our candidates for success. Our candidates have been relentless: knocking on doors by day, making calls by night, and presenting their vision to voters across the Commonwealth. We're giving this election cycle everything we've got, and we're ready to see the results on November 5th."

body:
Hundreds of voting system passwords were publicly shared by secretary of state’s office
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
Yesterday officially marked ONE WEEK to Election Day! Make sure that everyone in your life is getting out and VOTING. And in the meantime, make sure you're following RMV for all the latest news. Let's roll!

This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, October 30, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado GOP: Hundreds of voting system passwords were publicly shared by secretary of state’s office](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
More than 600 BIOS passwords for voting system components in 63 of the state’s 64 counties were publicly shared in a file on Secretary of State Jena Griswold’s website, a news release email from the Colorado Republican Party reads.
An unnamed state official “discretely removed” the passwords on Thursday, Oct. 24, the release states.
“The passwords were not encrypted or otherwise protected – this means they were available for public consumption,” the Colorado Republican Party’s email reads.
The file may have been posted publicly since August, with the amended file posted Oct. 24.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ELECTION MUST-READS 🗳️**
[**U.S. Postal Service advises voters to send mail-in ballots ASAP to ensure timely delivery**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **COLORADO POLITICS | STATE | OCTOBER 29** _The United States Postal Service (USPS) is advising voters who plan to cast their ballot by mail to do so soon to ensure their vote is counted in this year’s election._
[**How does the signature verification process work for ballot envelopes?**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **FOX 31 NEWS | STATE | OCTOBER 29** _Tuesday marks one week until election day, and the Problem Solvers have been getting questions about how the process works once ballots are received._
[**Bulletin highlights insider threats, terrorism and fires in ballot boxes as Election Day nears**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **THE GAZETTE | STATE | OCTOBER 29** _With Election Day only a week away, the number of threats to the voting processes are escalating, putting election officials, law enforcement and the federal government on a heightened state of alert. And Colorado has not been immune._ __
|
---
**[Evans to be joined by Bright, Gonzalez, Navarro, Woog in two town hall meetings this week](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Gabe Evans, the Republican candidate for Colorado’s 8th Congressional District, is hosting two town hall meetings this week with fellow GOP candidates, aiming to connect with voters before Election Day.
* Evans, joined by candidates like Scott Bright and Ryan Gonzalez, will address issues related to his campaign against Democratic incumbent Yadira Caraveo, who is considered vulnerable in her seat.
* The public town halls will be held in Greeley and Longmont, offering voters a chance to engage directly with Evans and discuss his priorities for the district.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Business owners ask City Council for help with homeless activity, get no action in Grand Junction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Grand Junction business owners have reported an increase in crime and unsafe conditions near the Homeward Bound Day Center for the homeless, impacting local businesses.
* Business owners asked City Council for help, noting frequent issues with trespassing, drug activity, and public disturbances but have yet to see any action taken.
* City Council members are divided on how to address the situation, with some advocating for stricter management or closure of the center, while others believe more time and resources are needed to evaluate its effectiveness.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[He’s back. Steve Bannon released after serving 4 months in federal prison, 1 week before election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former White House strategist Steve Bannon was released from federal prison after serving a four-month sentence for contempt of Congress related to defying a subpoena from the January 6 Committee.
* Bannon began his sentence in June after the Supreme Court denied his request to remain out pending appeal and called himself a "political prisoner" for opposing the Justice Department.
* Following his release, Bannon plans to resume his podcast and hold a news conference in Manhattan.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Walcher: Climate protocols are the ultimate entangling alliances with foreign governments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY GREG WALCHER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The “doctrine of unstable alliances” in George Washington’s “Farewell Address” underpinned U.S. foreign policy for decades and is still considered wise, though mostly ignored._
_“The great rule of conduct for us, in regard to foreign nations, is in extending our commercial relations, to have with them as little political connection as possible,” Washington wrote. “It is our true policy to steer clear of permanent alliances with any portion of the foreign world.”_
_Even the opposing party under President Thomas Jefferson continued to rely on that wisdom. He explained an “essential principle of our government,” in his inaugural address: “peace, commerce, and honest friendship with all nations, entangling alliances with none.”_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

They paused from their morning hunt and headed to the town park in camouflage, joining with neighbors and locals to meet candidates for election._

Chris Kolker or Republican challenger Robyn Carnes._

This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, October 30, 2024. – Heidi Ganahl | TODAY'S TOP STORIES More than 600 BIOS passwords for voting system components in 63 of the state’s 64 counties were publicly shared in a file on Secretary of State Jena Griswold’s website, a news release email from the Colorado Republican Party reads. An unnamed state official “discretely removed” the passwords on Thursday, Oct. 24, the release states. “The passwords were not encrypted or otherwise protected – this means they were available for public consumption,” the Colorado Republican Party’s email reads. The file may have been posted publicly since August, with the amended file posted Oct. 24. | ELECTION MUST-READS 🗳️ COLORADO POLITICS | STATE | OCTOBER 29 The United States Postal Service (USPS) is advising voters who plan to cast their ballot by mail to do so soon to ensure their vote is counted in this year’s election. FOX 31 NEWS | STATE | OCTOBER 29 Tuesday marks one week until election day, and the Problem Solvers have been getting questions about how the process works once ballots are received. THE GAZETTE | STATE | OCTOBER 29 With Election Day only a week away, the number of threats to the voting processes are escalating, putting election officials, law enforcement and the federal government on a heightened state of alert. And Colorado has not been immune. | Gabe Evans, the Republican candidate for Colorado’s 8th Congressional District, is hosting two town hall meetings this week with fellow GOP candidates, aiming to connect with voters before Election Day. Evans, joined by candidates like Scott Bright and Ryan Gonzalez, will address issues related to his campaign against Democratic incumbent Yadira Caraveo, who is considered vulnerable in her seat. The public town halls will be held in Greeley and Longmont, offering voters a chance to engage directly with Evans and discuss his priorities for the district. | Grand Junction business owners have reported an increase in crime and unsafe conditions near the Homeward Bound Day Center for the homeless, impacting local businesses. Business owners asked City Council for help, noting frequent issues with trespassing, drug activity, and public disturbances but have yet to see any action taken. City Council members are divided on how to address the situation, with some advocating for stricter management or closure of the center, while others believe more time and resources are needed to evaluate its effectiveness. | Former White House strategist Steve Bannon was released from federal prison after serving a four-month sentence for contempt of Congress related to defying a subpoena from the January 6 Committee. Bannon began his sentence in June after the Supreme Court denied his request to remain out pending appeal and called himself a "political prisoner" for opposing the Justice Department. Following his release, Bannon plans to resume his podcast and hold a news conference in Manhattan. | BY GREG WALCHER, The “doctrine of unstable alliances” in George Washington’s “Farewell Address” underpinned U.S. foreign policy for decades and is still considered wise, though mostly ignored. “The great rule of conduct for us, in regard to foreign nations, is in extending our commercial relations, to have with them as little political connection as possible,” Washington wrote. “It is our true policy to steer clear of permanent alliances with any portion of the foreign world.” Even the opposing party under President Thomas Jefferson continued to rely on that wisdom. He explained an “essential principle of our government,” in his inaugural address: “peace, commerce, and honest friendship with all nations, entangling alliances with none.” | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | OCTOBER 28 On Saturday in Nucla, Colo., hunters emerged from the wilderness. They paused from their morning hunt and headed to the town park in camouflage, joining with neighbors and locals to meet candidates for election. BY LINDY BROWNING | STATE | OCTOBER 28 From Deer Creek School District on the far Eastern Plains to Rangely on the western border of Utah, from Telluride and Aspen to Vail and Steamboat Springs, school districts all over rural Colorado are struggling with a need for affordable and available housing for teachers. BY HEIDI GANAHL | LOCAL | OCTOBER 24 In the race for Colorado’s Senate District 16, which represents Denver’s western suburbs, residents have a choice between incumbent Democratic Sen. Chris Kolker or Republican challenger Robyn Carnes._ Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share? We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. name: Kamala HQ
subject: If you knew that a few hours of your time could help elect Kamala Harris as the next President of the United States, wouldn’t it be worth it?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harris for President
body:
|
---
[](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1142?refcode=kh_em_do_20241030_b16_khq_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&amount=47&amounts=47%252C75%252C100%252C250%252C500&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241030_b16_khq_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=1&akid=221%2E2563979%2EZb-foR)
A few hours, an afternoon, or a day. That’s what we’re asking for, Peter. If you knew that volunteering just a few hours of your time would mean Donald Trump never set foot in the White House again, wouldn’t it be the best few hours of your life? If you knew that volunteering your afternoon meant continued progress in addressing climate change and lowering the cost of prescription drugs, wouldn’t you sign up for a shift today? name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: Shelby County Republican Party Request for Help (Oct 30, 2024)
body:
Hi Folks,

Every vote counts. One way we try to get every vote is to “chase” mail-in ballots, and we want to ask you for your help this year.

As of last night, 76% of the ballots that were mailed out to people in Shelby County have been returned to the Board of Elections.

That means 24% have not been returned. We want every Republican and Unaffiliated voter to return their ballot, preferably by hand-carrying it to the Board of Elections and handing it to the clerk across the counter.

Attached are the lists of Republican and Unaffiliated voters who have not returned their ballots as of last night. Please scan this list, and if you see a friend or family member, please give them a call and encourage them to get their ballot turned in.

Sadly, I see some people on the lists who have passed away recently. If you see a friend or family member of yours on these lists who passed away recently, please accept my condolences and my apology if seeing it causes you pain.

If anyone has any questions about how we came up with these lists, please don't hesitate to ask. All of this information is publicly available on the Secretary of State and/or the local Board of Elections website.

Let’s ensure a conservative win by getting our votes in early and making this **too big to rig**!!! Over 40% of Shelby County Republicans have already voted. Keep up this momentum by encouraging others to get it done early!!!

Cheers...Dan
(937) 206-2970
[cecilda.usaf@gmail.com](mailto:cecilda.usaf@gmail.com)

The **First Amendment** to the United States Constitution is one of the most critical components of American democracy. Ratified in 1791 as part of the Bill of Rights, it protects several fundamental freedoms: **freedom of speech, religion, press, assembly, and the right to petition the government**. These rights form the foundation of a free and open society, ensuring that individuals have the power to express their beliefs and ideas without fear of government retribution. Understanding the importance of the First Amendment helps underscore why it remains a cornerstone of the American legal and political system.
Freedom of Religion
The First Amendment begins by addressing religious freedom, a radical concept at its time. By preventing the establishment of a state religion and ensuring the free exercise of religion, the amendment creates a landscape where spiritual diversity can flourish without interference from the government. This protection not only safeguards individual beliefs but also fosters a pluralistic society where religious tolerance is not just a policy but a societal norm. This freedom has allowed the United States to become a melting pot of faiths, contributing to cultural richness and social harmony.
Freedom of Speech and the Press
Perhaps the most debated and celebrated aspect of the First Amendment is the freedom of speech. This freedom is crucial for a democratic society, enabling open discourse, the exchange of ideas, and the ability to critique and influence government policies. The press, often referred to as the fourth estate, plays an integral role in this ecosystem. By ensuring that media can operate without undue censorship, the First Amendment allows for accountability, transparency, and an informed public. This freedom has been vital in moments of national crisis, enabling journalism to act as a watchdog against corruption.
Rights to Assemble and Petition
The rights to assemble and petition are equally pivotal. They allow citizens to gather, express, and advocate for change, ensuring that the government remains responsive to the people. These rights have been instrumental in various movements throughout American history, from civil rights marches to protests against war. They provide a non-violent means for societal grievances to be aired and addressed, reinforcing the democratic process.
The Amendment's Role in Modern Times
In today's digital age, the First Amendment's importance has not diminished; it has evolved. The internet and social media platforms have become new battlegrounds where freedom of speech is both exercised and contested. The amendment's principles guide how we navigate the complexities of online discourse, privacy, and the spread of information.
The First Amendment is more than a legal safeguard; it is a fundamental pillar of American identity. It ensures that the United States remains a place where ideas can compete freely, religions can coexist, and where the people have the power to influence their government peacefully. As society evolves, the principles of the First Amendment continue to be crucial in defending democracy, promoting tolerance, and fostering an environment where every voice can contribute to the nation's discourse. It reminds us that liberty, once granted by God, must be continually protected and nurtured. The First Amendment does not just protect rights; it actively shapes the character of the United States, making it a beacon of freedom for the world.

body:

name: Lucas Tyree Kunce
subject: I’m a veteran who was exposed to toxic burn pits in Iraq...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
...and Republicans like Josh Hawley abandoned veterans like me
#
Peter — I’m Lt. Col. Lucas Kunce, USMCR, 13 years of active duty.
**After three tours of duty in Iraq and Afghanistan, I never imagined I would return home and face more attacks.** But that’s what happened two years ago, when Josh Hawley and 40 other Republicans blocked a bill to expand healthcare to millions of veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits during their service.
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81101?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL)**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81101?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL)
**Let me tell you what happened, so you know why I’m running for U.S. Senate.**
In Iraq, I deployed to the Sunni Triangle where I led a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman, running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi. **From our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.**
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81101?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL)
When I got home from that deployment, I had developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. **And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits.** Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt when politicians who have never worn the uniform, like Josh Hawley, threw us a giant middle finger and voted against aid for veterans who were exposed to these toxic burn pits.
I know that’s harsh language, but it has to be. Because what they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country — and that’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
**[If you’re with me, will you please consider donating $10 or anything at all so we can get this message in front of voters and defeat Josh Hawley this November? I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs in this race, so any amount you can give will have a massive impact on our grassroots campaign.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81101?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL)**

[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81102?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=5&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81102?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=6&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81102?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=7&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81102?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=8&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81102?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=9&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81102?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=10&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/81101?refcode=em20241030-8294&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=8294%2E614464%2EgeO2bL)

subject: My decision...

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2146%2E135344%2Ecd0PVe)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241030-1-900&t=2&akid=2146%2E135344%2Ecd0PVe)
---
Friends --
While I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails ahead of Election Day, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**
[**That is why I would love it if you would consider donating $3 or whatever you can to my campaign as we're now in the final sprint.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241030-1-900&t=3&akid=2146%2E135344%2Ecd0PVe)**

# October 30, 2024
---
|
# My Supporters
---
---
| Much is made in political races about ENDORSEMENTS. As Election Day is fast approaching, many voters will do a quick look at candidates' websites and make a decision on who to support based on if they "recognize the names" of endorsers. My opponent, who has been in government for over 40 years, easily collects "endorsements" from those who expect something in return when they run for office or look for a government handout.
I would prefer that voters look at my "SUPPORTERS" because it says a lot about what I stand for:
PARENTAL RIGHTS and PROTECTION OF CHILDREN
---
| State Senator Shannon Grove has fought hard to protect children in California including SB1414 which passed in the recent session of the California Legislature and was signed into law by the governor. This bill changed the penalty for child sex trafficking from a misdemeanor to a felony.
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
Also endorsing my campaign is Erin Friday, Esq., a Democrat, attorney and mom who has relentlessly fought for changes to state law after her child was secretly transitioned at school. |

PUBLIC SAFETY
---
| While my opponent has done nothing to counter the "Defund the Police" and open border terror facilitated by her party, I have a couple new supporters among law enforcement individuals and organizations who are publicly supporting me.
Ruben Chavez, formerly San Jose police officer, currently the Chief of Police of Gustine, and Denise Turner, the chief of Police of Gilroy both strong advocates for public safety and both support my campaign.
---
|
---
---
|
DEFENSE of MARGINALIZED COMMUNITIES
---
|
The support of the Bay Area Jewish Coalition is very important to me because I stand firmly behind these communities and support for Israel.
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
The Muwekma Ohlone Tribe has been marginalized for years by my opponent. I am proud that Democrat Charlene Nijmeh, Tribal Chairwomen of the tribe, and a rival in the Primary Election, endorsed me.
| My own Hispanic Community has been marginalized for decades, seen only as a "reliable" voting block by California politicians. I am excited that faith leaders like Dr. Sonny and Dr. Linda Lara (Morgan Hill), have stood up and spread the word that Hispanics need to examine what a candidate stands for and not blindly vote for a person based on their last name.

|

| | |
---|---

Finally, I would be remiss in not highlighting, Carina Powers and the Republican National Hispanic Assembly for their ongoing support.
|
I'm humbled by the outpouring of support for my campaign. Please check out my website for other supporters.

Derek — Our
end-of-month fundraising deadline is tomorrow and the election is 6 days
away. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=oct2024_abs_em.VpOmzl&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20241030_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=8075%2E5257348%2EBuV27Q ]Can I count on you to pitch in any amount today?

Let me explain why the stakes are so high:

Donald Trump has been running with a new line of attack against Democrats
— including me — over the last few weeks. And it’s potentially his most
dangerous one yet.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20241030_AM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=8075%2E5257348%2EBuV27Q ]The New York Times: Trump Escalates Threats to Political Opponents He
Deems the 'Enemy' Never before has a presidential nominee openly suggested
turning the military on Americans simply because they oppose his
candidacy. With voting underway, Donald Trump has turned to dark vows of
retribution.

Trump is openly threatening to call in the military to suppress his
political opponents. Calling us “the enemy within,” and saying that we are
more dangerous than foreign autocrats like Vladimir Putin.

Ever since I investigated Russia’s support for Trump in 2016 and impeached
him for high crimes and misdemeanors, he has characterized me as public
enemy number one. But never before would I expect to be threatened with
the force of the United States military.

What’s potentially even worse, is that Trump’s MAGA allies across the
country are defending him. They’re too afraid to stand up to him —
otherwise, they’ll face a similar fate to Adam Kinzinger and Liz Cheney,
Republicans brave enough to speak out.

Derek, whether
it was the insurrection on January 6, his efforts to interfere in
elections, his support for voter suppression, or his allies' creation of
the Project 2025 plan, Trump’s actions have chipped away at our democratic
institutions.

He even told his supporters that if they vote in November, they’ll "never
have to vote again," and explicitly stated to Sean Hannity on Fox News his
desire to be a dictator on day one.

Enough. I’m running for Senate to ensure we hold would-be autocrats like
Donald Trump accountable and stop his MAGA movement from seizing power.

Derek, Donald
Trump loathes me — because I investigated him, led his impeachment trial,
and investigated his abuses of power on the January 6 Committee. And no
matter how he tries to threaten or intimidate me, I will never back down.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20241030_AM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1007&akid=8075%2E5257348%2EBuV27Q ]Your
$10 of
support today will help me win this Senate race and continue to hold Trump
to account. We must defeat him in November. Trump’s vicious brand of
autocratic politics has no place in our country.

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Peter, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

# ▶️: The Cost of Inaction

Elections have consequences, and we’ve seen the results.
In 2022, **Republican Congressman Morgan Luttrell** was elected, and since then, our Congress has failed us.
[**Take 70 seconds to understand the real consequences of my opponent's inaction on issues that affect us all:**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=8ea4cdc241&e=a2a46ff12c)

While my opponent takes **photos with Trump** , real issues are left unaddressed.
In the last two years, only 27 pieces of legislation have passed—compared to 325 in the previous session.

If you’re ready for someone who fights for the issues that matter—affordable healthcare, restored rights, and accountable leadership—**I’m asking for your vote.**
