| | | | Dear Friend, **Early Voting in Ohio has started. Bank your vote by voting absentee or early in person!** As your Congressman, I’ve fought hard to deliver real results for our community. I have worked to double jobs at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base to over 38,000 and secured hundreds of millions of dollars for its expansion. I’ve also brought over $14.5 million in federal funding for local childcare centers, fought the opioid crisis, and helped **reduce taxes for middle-class families** by increasing the child tax credit to $2,000 per child. With your support, I will continue working to: -Secure our border -Fight inflation -Protect tax-payer dollars -Lower prescription drug costs **There is more to be done and I cannot do it without your support**. I ask for your vote so that I may continue to fight for you and our community. Voting has never been more secure and easy with the options of election day, early in-person, and absentee by mail voting. **For information about early voting, click on the button below.**

Democrats deliver.

Kamala Harris delivered.
Now let's deliver for her.
\- Gavin Newsom

clean_body: The sooner you give, the further your dollars will go. | | | Peter, we are so close to electing Kamala Harris as our next president. But the job isn't done. We’ve still got more work to do until Election Day. Millions have yet to cast their vote, and tomorrow is the final end-of-month fundraising deadline of the election. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | In a democracy, the power rests with us to put in the work to elect the candidates we believe in. Make no mistake, Kamala has the vision we need to turn the page and write a new chapter in our country's history. But we each have a decision to make, Peter. Will we pitch in a few bucks to invest in the organizers and last-minute ads that will help defeat Donald Trump? Or will we hold out hope that somebody else is going to do it? Trust me, Kamala's team would breathe a big sigh of relief if donations from supporters like you came through today. And the sooner you give, the further your dollars will go. So, let's not get complacent. Let's all do our part to make sure Kamala and Tim are on track to win. I hope you’ll join me to step up at this unprecedented moment. Thank you, Barack Barack Obama | | | |

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Friends, this November is a huge deal.
Yes, I’m talking about the historic election in front of us in less than one week — we’re all working around the clock to ensure that my husband Tim Kaine is re-elected, that we send Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to the White House, and that we flip the House of Representatives to a Democratic majority.
But what you probably don’t know is that this November is also a big milestone for Tim and me personally — we will celebrate our 40th wedding anniversary on November 24th, 2024!
In honor of our 40th, I wanted to share a few favorite pix from over the years...
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
The dating days... were we ever so young?!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
This is from our wedding announcement in the Richmond Times-Dispatch.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
With then-Senator Barack Obama and Michelle Obama in 2007, while Tim was Governor of Virginia and Barack was running for president.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Tim being sworn in as U.S. Senator in 2013 by then-Vice President Joe Biden as I held the bible.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
At the Democratic National Convention in 2016. What a time!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Canoeing Virginia’s James River together
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
And of course, launching Tim’s 2024 re-election campaign!

It is in that spirit that Tim is running for re-election. Like me — and like you — he believes in Virginia, and believes in the future we can create if good hearts and hard work come together.

# 6 Days to Go—and Every Dollar Counts!
---
|
We’re down to the wire—just 6 days left until Election Day! And with the end of the month here, we’re making one final push to ensure we have the resources to cross the finish line strong.
We’ve come so far together, and we’re closer than ever to flipping this seat. But it’s not too late to make a difference. Every single dollar you contribute in these last days will help us turn out voters and secure a victory for our community.

Here’s how your donation can have an immediate impact:
* **$25** will help us send crucial last-minute reminders to voters who haven’t turned in their ballots.

* **$50** will allow us to keep our digital ads running and reach even more undecided voters.

* **Whatever you can give** will help us stay competitive in these final critical days.

We’ve got the momentum, the energy, and the people behind us—but we need the resources to bring it home. Can you chip in **$25, $50, or whatever you can today?
** This is our chance to make history, and your support is the key to turning this district blue. Let’s finish strong—**every spare dollar counts!
** Thank you for your unwavering support as we head into these final days.

In solidarity,
River Gassen
Democratic Candidate for U.S. Congress, Colorado - 5

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=103024_1&amount=25]
AP: Mississippi has a history of voter suppression. Many see signs of change as Black voters reengage [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=103024_1&amount=25]
Team, what happened in Mississippi's last election and the movement we're seeing this year should give us all pause and show us why we need to fight in every state nationwide.
Mississippi has an egregious voting rights record and has the highest level of felony disenfranchisement in the country. A Jim Crow-era constitutional provision enables Mississippi to disenfranchise more than 10% of its total voting-age population and its disenfranchisement of Black voters exceeds 15% .
Mississippi has no early voting opportunities and a narrow set of qualifications for those seeking to vote absentee, meaning that the vast majority of ballots are cast on Election Day. This inaccessibility contributes to the state’s notoriously dismal voter turnout: In this year’s primary election, only 30% of those registered to vote turned out, the lowest rate since 2007.
On Election Day 2023 at least nine polling locations in the state’s most populous county — Hinds County, home of the city of Jackson — ran out of ballots multiple times throughout the day . The fight to extend polling hours became a confusing jumble of legal filings and contradicting orders all as voters waited in line -- and many left entirely due to the lack of ballots .
Also in Hinds County, opponents of voting rights in the state legislature have previously taken aim at Jackson and its over 80% Black population by creating a new court system with an unelected judge in a portion of Jackson and expanding the state-run Capitol Police force’s jurisdiction to cover the entire city rather than just a handful of government buildings.
Mississippi's playbook is clear: Disenfranchise, limit ballot access, obscure legal pathways for justice, rely on Jim Crow laws still on the books, and codify control for decades. Their endgame is power and control , not fairness or freedom.

* **TOP NEWS**

"**North Texas doctor sentenced to prison in $54 million Medicare fraud,** " Dallas Morning News' **Sarah Bahari** -- "A North Texas doctor was sentenced to 10 years and one month in prison Tuesday for a [scheme to defraud Medicare](https://substack.com/redirect/c369c18a-12e4-4701-97c5-b81b7fb4b8e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) out of millions of dollars, authorities said.

Dr. **Daniel Canchola** , 54, of Flower Mound, accepted bribes and kickbacks for ordering bogus cancer screening tests and medical equipment, the Justice Department said. Canchola, who pleaded guilty in 2022 to conspiracy to commit wire fraud, was also ordered to pay $34 million in restitution.

Federal prosecutors say Canchola signed scores of phony doctor's orders for genetic cancer tests without examining or speaking to patients, who were recruited at health fairs and by telemarketers.

Between August 2018 to April 2019, Canchola received about $30 for each order, totaling more than $466,000 in kickbacks, federal court documents say. Orders signed by Canchola were then used to submit more than $54 million in fraudulent claims to Medicare.

Canchola's arrest in 2019 was part of a nationwide bust targeting fraudulent genetic cancer testing, which the Justice Department called "[one of the largest health care fraud schemes ever charged](https://substack.com/redirect/c369c18a-12e4-4701-97c5-b81b7fb4b8e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." The case produced charges against 35 people in several states, including Texas, Florida and Georgia, according to federal officials. A total of $2.1 billion was billed to Medicare for the bogus DNA tests.

The nine physicians, including Canchola, were associated with telemedicine companies that provided remote care and cancer genetic testing laboratories. Two other Texas physicians, Dr.**Sekhar Rao** and Dr. **Vinay Parameswara** , both of Austin, were also convicted in the scheme." Dr. Daniel Canchola , 54, of Flower Mound, accepted bribes and kickbacks for ordering bogus cancer screening tests and medical equipment, the Justice Department said. Canchola, who pleaded guilty in 2022 to conspiracy to commit wire fraud, was also ordered to pay $34 million in restitution. Federal prosecutors say Canchola signed scores of phony doctor's orders for genetic cancer tests without examining or speaking to patients, who were recruited at health fairs and by telemarketers. Between August 2018 to April 2019, Canchola received about $30 for each order, totaling more than $466,000 in kickbacks, federal court documents say. Orders signed by Canchola were then used to submit more than $54 million in fraudulent claims to Medicare. Canchola's arrest in 2019 was part of a nationwide bust targeting fraudulent genetic cancer testing, which the Justice Department called "." The case produced charges against 35 people in several states, including Texas, Florida and Georgia, according to federal officials. A total of $2.1 billion was billed to Medicare for the bogus DNA tests. The nine physicians, including Canchola, were associated with telemedicine companies that provided remote care and cancer genetic testing laboratories. Two other Texas physicians, Dr.Sekhar Rao and Dr. Vinay Parameswara , both of Austin, were also convicted in the scheme." **I’m Mike Holmgren.** While you might know me as a former Green Bay Packers coach (including in 1997, when we defeated the Patriots in the Super Bowl!), what you might not know is that I’m also the husband of a nurse and the father of four daughters, including one who is a high-risk OB/GYN.

**Today, I’d like to take a moment to tell you why – along with my family including my daughter Calla, who like Kristin is an OB/GYN – I’m supporting Kristin Lyerly for Congress, and why I’m asking you to[ _join me in supporting her._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96155950/509085536/246552325?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_Holmgren_241030_T1_1&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_holmgren_241030_t1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZWY3ZDEwZS1kNDk2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T5RuC07NolwDkbMsyyYCHub8uV1XBewwiAncIHkfajk=)**

In the past years, since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and paved the way for states and ultra-conservative politicians to restrict health care, we’ve seen devastating consequences for women and pregnant patients around the country.

Here in Wisconsin, for 15 months abortion was banned by a law from back before the Packers were even founded (for those not counting, that was 105 years ago – the law dates back to _1849_). Reproductive rights have been restored in Wisconsin, but for millions in states where abortion is banned, that’s not the case.

My daughter Calla has seen more than a few difficult cases – cases that make it crystal clear why politicians simply have no place in our health care decisions. Cases where there are no easy answers or easy choices.

I’m no stranger to tough fights, and I’ve led my teams to victory plenty of times. This is another tough fight. Kristin is up against a Trump-backed opponent who has the support of the Republican establishment.

**But it’s a fight that we absolutely must win. Our future – and our children’s futures – depend on it.**

Peter,

The most important fundraising deadline of the election is just a day away, and according to the latest update from my fundraising team, we’re still trailing our goal by about $12,500.

I’ll explain more in a moment, but the bottom line is we need all the help we can get right now. If you’re able to contribute, please make a donation before the final fundraising deadline of the election on Thursday, October 31.

DONATE: http://secure.actblue.com/donate/em241030ke?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=express_lane_25

With less than one week until Election Day, polls indicate that Republicans could win our state for the first time since 1972. The latest MinnPost-Embold Research poll highlights just how close this race is, showing a razor-thin margin between Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris.

I can’t stress enough how critical it is for our people-powered movement to dig deep and finish this race strong. With reproductive freedom, civil rights, and so much more at stake, all of us need to do our part to keep Minnesota blue and elect DFLers up and down the ballot.

This is the LAST end-of-month deadline before November 5. We’re counting on grassroots supporters like you to pitch in and provide the resources we need to boost Democratic turnout across Minnesota and elect DFLers up and down the ballot.

Our records show that you’re still eligible for Minnesota’s Political Contribution Refund (PCR) program, but you’re running out of time to make a difference in this election. You only have a few days left to make a $75 donation (or $150 for couples) and receive a full refund from the state of Minnesota.

Peter, will you make your refundable $75 donation right now to help us reach our end-of-month goal and Get Out the Vote in Minnesota?

## Supreme Court: Kennedy Stays on the Ballot
The Supreme Court [rejected a last-minute appeal](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAUhH-NvREBDwwMDF2ypWtHi5hH_FoMlk0S-d9X7t7hhtNJp0_f1228BcpUHp9hQd9SHSWXignOgI8xUD5G1UefECVCj14Y4MDBDrqfvXPgVLJGOQt6Qu6iE2CFlC4Im5LqyZ9vggMXWhslLsYOKcBgdNAxJiM7xTFSq9vlu1JpM6Z81Bdul6kuffZza-vewUcnr528hrXgez-ns2yNpoydvP5gKRgPtj_XDRdkU31ujd1DzrWxhaaZHqGwN-1TLTsVpiDahGcGFy2qe8IUAeUdnECXdL_5uL4pZ9oH0yn-WALlP6D2n6CXl78BAAD__-XNZ9Y) on Tuesday to remove Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s name from the ballot in Wisconsin and Michigan. Kennedy sought to have his name withdrawn from these battleground states after dropping out of the race and endorsing former President Donald Trump. Votes cast for Kennedy could impact a close race, even though he's no longer running. The court provided no reason for rejecting Kennedy’s appeal. However, election officials in Wisconsin and Michigan described the [ballot change as impossible](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uwyAYAJ8Gb1jw8ecMDF28pUtUdbQIfMSk2FiYJPLbV-ne-aTT6b7P09mlnNbbp1vQtlgmYCApZ1SwKbiUj0l2wUZEQNGh5UYwwcSgVTfbKL3GCAxPV_De6WBwUFI7dwJhhuHUJfu2cSYYV8pI3ptBRye0UU6FEA0QyTCkVmp_L2ltM8Z8lCfW3pely3ZubduJ-CAwEhjd1a_42vtbeWMC49eFwPhKFS-t1IPAuD-2igtSXx610Yp39G2n22OfacWlPJHWcsXa6A-uK4aD3ivlXMHADRddtWF7pZzTrg2R7La4lP9C2n9jnhZ-AwAA__9_gmXa) because early voting is already well underway.
## More Newspapers End Endorsements
_USA Today_ announced Monday that it [will not endorse a presidential candidate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1vhDAMhn9N2ILyRTiGDF3YrmtHZIg5XAWCktwh_n3FqerWzbJeP4_1ft2HO1Cg7fEJK7oyx0EJZbgUXIvBA4VzMJV3M6JCXaGTrRZa6JttqsVNspsBoOusAtOMjW5HPxqrrO-MkCNW5C6aFFrIpmmNrNubnUHbtoHG-7lVzAj0VGKqvyNtZcE5nPGFqZ7iWgW3lLJnpj-Y6pnqj-Oo9xio0BSvAFN9oBfy5-6hYGaqv2xM9VJcc_e74BhwKhS3zN_x6RLA4--OwwbhzHQBnhl4iR5OjpuPKeOKW-ElPdedL5ASZS6EvFlhTJWc3w8KgbJtmRGPFSi8_y7_9fhy6icAAP__2hR0og) this election cycle, joining the _Los Angeles Times_ and _Washington Post_ in sidestepping the traditional journalism practice. The _Minnesota Star Tribune_ , _Sun Sentinel_ , _Tampa Bay Times_ , and the _Omaha World-Herald_ , are among other larger regional and national newspapers not endorsing a candidate. The move may be motivated by papers unwilling to lose revenue and readers, [according to an industry expert](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uwyAURp_G3rD4JwwMXbKla0fr2lxiEmwsQEF5-yrdO37Sp6Oj83ObbxBTPO7fsKNrIc-cckkYJYLOHmJ6z3L0LiByFCM6ZgQVVFy0Gjdn5bJIa22wimKgq1IMlLHSGK2Nx3WM7kNjVFCmlJFsMhcdQGijQHkfDB8kRR9bLtMjx6NtGNI7v7BMa97H5LbWzjqIr4FfB37tvU8H9toRn5_DwK-fecKJpZK2QSMLrE_05JGRLNHjQRLURlrckfR8NIKHz6UiecIOCcgGpcRKmDVaMjEW588eU4pVm0HS-w4x_Zm0_8q8HP8NAAD__90_ZrY). The Washington Post [reportedly lost over 200,000 digital subscriptions](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO6yAQheGngc7RMGCwC4orXbnLtltaJIzDrLCxDJsob7_y9lsf6TvS_3mdr4Ezb4-PsJJvS5kR0HQKOg1zDJzfs5HRL0RIWpJXToMGPdheJq8suDGq253QusG40YwjAFowUY9IKNmfmgINqu-dURc32CVo6_rQx7g4FAYocivH5avw1hIt-V2edFzuZZXZp9b2KvQ_gZPAqSVKnPO5CZxSWWmjVxU4rRQ5CJzM2Dunh-4VauLt0crW7aW2rn7f6v3gvXHZahePsp-gntrtoEXo_2mXh4_7i3Pmap0w8FgD_x7J9leUp8efAAAA__9LQGK2)—about 8% of its digital and print subscribers—since deciding not to endorse Vice President Kamala Harris. Jeff Bezos, the Washington Post owner, on Monday [defended the decision](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAUBp8GOix-jVNQ3MZdbrulhc0hPhGGyKCg7NOvvP12n_RJM9J83Ze7x4T58d8f4Fosi-RSM8GZ4kvwmD6LpsFFAAmKghNWccXVNBq6uyi0h5uNGmL0gk-ThSBXa9fNrDc73ii6iya44sIYq8VgpzF6NVrjTQjRSqI5BGzlHJ4Fc9shpk95wzls5aDJ7a29KlH_iJyJnHvvw7bWDL1eP5HzNYmcnxAjW-G7VNZ93TE_WsnsVWpjkEM5KxyQGwuwYcWSiZzp6cKrY0pYR0s0fxwe06-0_RXh7eRPAAAA__8132CN), calling it "principled," as Americans believe the media is biased.
## Comedic Actress Teri Garr Dead at 79
Teri Garr, an [Oscar-nominated comedic actress](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GOqzAQheGnsbug8djGULi4DV1uuyWa4HFw1uAILFDefsX22x3pSJ_0f93HO6Wc1ud_WtjXWEYENDcFNw1joJQ_o5HBR2ZkLdkrp0GD7lorZ29oAmWg7YgMdoAIQKpHiAG6PnCQyV-aAg3KWmdU47o2km6dJRtCdCgMcEi1bM2rpLXOHPOnHLw1U1lk9nOt713ofwIHgcN5ns3jMV2fwGHlcxc40FbTlPma04uht7097HeRmw_vM-Wc9tYJA8-FUv5V61-Vh8efAAAA__-XlFJJ) renowned for her roles in _Young Frankenstein_ , _Mr. Mom_ , and _Tootsie_ , has died from complications related to multiple sclerosis. She was 79. In a career spanning over 40 years, Garr captivated audiences with her quirky persona and quick wit, becoming [a familiar face](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kr1yozAAhJ8GOjxCAgQFBYlNSBw75_-LG0bWD8gW4AiBjjz9jVPezLW7O1-x851W5YpIJdtqTRqeGtGVEMDA84GHQMmIVFMZuCwVnEOOXJ76GAEEUByFbp1eEE1oRJMEwDBBDJKLH4uAoQSTAHGSuDJ90HyAgB-GOPBnOI4EQREOSciYwNAJAGfSdHp27WRrai7U1I1cz2jXuCqtjbn3DsocmDswt9bOJlJ33aN1YM5bw7Uhsm14axyYMzJK5iluDNcNaT1KlOo9w7X0KqK1ByHwIUAIzGrTKAfl1UBpNzwoDpr7DoyqgfJSc8G1_slIsQW0WEXvU4IYosNno4bzFF4vEIz_zsteVg6aZ5ssy4qnJbnY9nqCUxMXK4vHPy8hmiq4-8rwS7Y__LJmb9d4fxTX5fP2_XwzN-Ev-83hrcBeqz-qTj33NsM2DIJa1mJRCzPX3u21_Kx4u74Xy6dLp0V9U2Krv-nXLi6-_eK4IB8xKab4edMJH56Og7XtlL9t8it5ZSNdVgdD94jKLfwN1G7DFmfq6pTdrVRK9hF2AlA1RKqf-83_dBhT-DcAAP__Tl-5pw) in movies and on sitcoms and late-night shows. Television host David Letterman called her one of his favorite guests. _Mr. Mom_ co-star Michael Keaton described Garr as legendary and her comedic work, especially in _Young Frankenstein,_ as “great.” You can [see a clip here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z8FKxDAUheGnSXZTbnJvknGRhSjd6AiDguCmxCZpI-lk6GRa-vZS927PgQ_-z1N3cimny_DmpmBrLJ0ESQcBB4TOu5S3jri3MQQZkAcrDAICHrXio33QUkevyZOQygEene97QdTrSCAh8mR3TQCCUMqQaMxRR4faKKe8j0YyguBTLXPzU9KljiHmrSxhbvoy8WzHWq83ho9Mtky267o2W7nX-3fY_31xtR8ZtgvD56-Xp6F-vL_q85nP1l_XlHO6acMIhsml_EfW_xIXK38DAAD__-jcUbU). Garr is survived by her daughter, Molly O’Neil, and a grandson, Tyryn. [You can see her life in photos here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uwyAUQOGngY2I3wseGLp4S9eOFgoX-1bYWBilyttX6d75SJ90vu7LPVGlY_1MO8ZR2qKltkJJYeSSE9XXYnmOBVGj4RiVN9JIE8DxLbpH8r5AUKDBBAcgy5RTTsEYZZ1GTvGtKWmkcs5bdfMBSjLgXXI5F6-ZlZhptH77bnSMDUt9tSf226PtvMZtjPNi5oPpmen5xHZWfCem54GdxJp6F5UKCjrEubXRLhHcNIEE3mM-f6hWusAzK9c9Uf1jx3-bz6h_AwAA__8GaVLN)

Kennedy Jr.’s name from the ballot in Wisconsin and Michigan. Kennedy sought to have his name withdrawn from these battleground states after dropping out of the race and endorsing former President Donald Trump. Votes cast for Kennedy could impact a close race, even though he's no longer running. The court provided no reason for rejecting Kennedy’s appeal. However, election officials in Wisconsin and Michigan described the because early voting is already well underway. The Minnesota Star Tribune , Sun Sentinel , Tampa Bay Times , and the Omaha World-Herald , are among other larger regional and national newspapers not endorsing a candidate. The move may be motivated by papers unwilling to lose revenue and readers, . The Washington Post —about 8% of its digital and print subscribers—since deciding not to endorse Vice President Kamala Harris. As an NDRC supporter, you know that we’re investing in races that are critical to shoring up our rights in the short term as well as the long-term fight for fairness. A series of sprints add up to a marathon. Being successful in these 2024 elections could help lay the foundation for an even fairer redistricting process in 2031. But falling short could pave the way for more GOP gerrymandering.
**That’s why we have to leave it all on the field between now and Tuesday.[Donate now.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96157745/509090846/1485360112?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StepUpRedux_email_20241030-NDRC-Tier1-StepUpRedux-NOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241030-NDRC-Tier1-StepUpRedux-NOR_&utm_campaign=StepUpRedux&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxMjkxMmVjLWQ2OTYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=HLLJzNMAEA3hHsq9G9Vrp03S9_sgvS_1U2G4ZzAaovc=)**
It’s impossible to overstate how important state supreme court, state legislature, governor, and state ballot races are when it comes to shoring up our democracy. The fate of these races could have a direct outcome on upcoming redistricting — and the effort we make between now and next Tuesday could determine countless people’s ability to make their voices heard in our democracy.
We know the presidential race is sucking up a lot of oxygen, for good reason. **But it’s imperative that we win these state-level races that will determine whether Republicans can gerrymander over the next few years. **

body:

Peter — getting a flat tire now would be disastrous for our campaign.
**[Can I count on you to split $10 to my campaign in the next 24 hours?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241030-3?refcode=em20241030-3&refcode2=4721_552475_kp-RmY&akid=4721%2E552475%2Ekp-RmY)**
**[Donate ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241030-3?refcode=em20241030-3&refcode2=4721_552475_kp-RmY&akid=4721%2E552475%2Ekp-RmY)**
Asking for money is one of the worst parts of the job — but with the election in 6 days, I hope you’ll understand why I’m reaching out.
**We have a major fundraising goal at midnight _tomorrow_ , and it’s crucial that we reach our targets.**
Mitch McConnell and his buddies are looking for any signs of vulnerabilities. If we miss our fundraising goal, we’ll have to pull down our ads and open the door for even more outside spending from McConnell’s super PACs.

subject: Residency challenges hit PA mail-in requests
body:
The Bolt: New breaking news from Broad + Liberty | | | |
---
| | |
---
| **NEW:**_**Activists challenge hundreds of mail-in ballot applications, citing non-residency**_
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=bbc9d74d75&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| A group of local activists in southeastern Pennsylvania is presently challenging 865 mail-in ballot applications in Pennsylvania’s suburban southeastern counties, citing evidence that many applicants moved. The disputers, who asked for anonymity to avoid potential harassment, obtained voter data from the commonwealth’s Statewide Uniform Registry of Electors (SURE) and identified voters who filed a permanent national change of address form. They then checked those names against mail-in ballot requests for the November general election. _Broad + Liberty_ reviewed the list of disputed applicants containing 514 Democrats, 221 Republicans, and 130 others. The activists are not challenging anyone who filed a permanent change of address form after the April primary. (Someone who has moved [can still vote](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3a0fe7ec32&e=b7b3eddce2) in their old precinct in the very next election after moving, but not after that.) While most of the people on the list incurred a ballot-request challenge from the activists based on change of address — in many cases out of state — about 7.5 percent of those listed were indicated as unregistered anywhere in Pennsylvania. The reason in each case is not known; the activists cited registration cancellation or death as possible explanations...

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: this is about all we have left
body:
Dear Peter,

There's 6 days until the election – which means you and I don’t have much time left!

Our students are doubling down and making a final push to turn out the pro-life youth vote in the swing states for the Presidential, U.S. Senate, and State Legislative races as well as Abortion Ballot Referendum states.

A critical part of that is our peer-to-peer texting program, where our students reach out to undecided voters one-by-one via text message.

The great news is, this program allows our student activists to have real conversations about the horrible realities of abortion with young, undecided voters in key states and districts.

With news outlets like The Atlantic reporting that, “Gen Z is poised to massively expand its influence in the 2024 election,” we need all hands on deck to reach them!

The problem is, it costs roughly $0.06 to contact each voter this way once you factor in the costs of data and the texting platform.

Can I count on your most generous contribution to help us cover the costs of our last-push texting blitz
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/dKQFw-p6ZQRRy5LNkrh3BA~~/AAVkMwA~
?

Peter, I’ll be honest.

With all the programs we’re running to turn people against abortion, the funds for this crucial program are limited, and the costs for our text message program, which we proven in 2022 to be impactful, just increased over the weekend (due to “software” issues).

And the Abortion Goliath is coming at young voters from every angle, believing they’ll deliver Planned Parenthood TOTAL control of Washington, D.C.

So, now more than ever, we need to reach those who haven’t committed to turning out to vote for Life!

And I’d hate to tell our passionate student volunteers that I don’t have the resources to put them to work.

So, please agree to your most generous contribution to help fund this important program
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/jcQHfaf9zIcqygivMXMZRw~~/AAVkMwA~
.

Every gift is a critical part in the fight for preborn lives.

And I want to thank you for all of your support.

Together, we’re creating a Culture of Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action
Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

1000 Winchester St., Suite 301
Fredericksburg, VA 22401
Office: 540.834.4600

Students for Life of America is a Section 501(c)(3) charity under the Internal Revenue Code. As such, your gift is tax-deductible to the fullest extent of the law. When the amount needed for the specific need(s) referenced in this communication is raised, any contributions that exceed the amount needed will be used in the area of greatest need as determined by Students for Life of America, even if that need is unrelated to the specific request in this communication.

name: Neil Parrott
subject: Better than a Muffin?
body:
Muffins are pretty great, but so is the fact that SEVEN National Leaders will be in FREDERICK tomorrow morning! I hope you will join us. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=cc6f884bca)
---
|
---
| | Peter,

Muffins are pretty great, but so is the fact that **SEVEN National Leaders** will be in our community tomorrow morning!! This Congressional race is that important. Please join me this Thursday morning, October 31, 2024, from 8:30-9:30am, in Frederick. I am honored to have the following guests at this event:

**Majority Leader Steve Scalise, Congressman Jason Smith, Congressman Dale Strong, Congressman Brad Finstad, Congressman Mike Collins, Congressman Mark Alford, and Former Kansas AG Derek Schmidt.**

These leaders in DC recognize that this race could be one of the most important races in the entire country. We can win this race - Join us Thursday morning.
---
| [Click for Tickets - Thursday Morning](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=b1c9e4e16e&e=5a45ee1154 "Click for Tickets - Thursday Morning")

---
| Today and tomorrow, October 30 and October 31, are the last two days for early voting. Please take advantage of this opportunity! Voting early makes sure that your vote is in...You never know what Election Day will look like in your life! PLUS, I am hopeful that many of you in Maryland will be free to help me greet voters at a polling location near you. We need your help. Could you contact us to see what is possible over the next week?
---
|
---
| [CLICK HERE TO WATCH MY AD THAT STANDS UP FOR THE TRUTH](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=fbca46d48d&e=5a45ee1154 "CLICK HERE TO WATCH MY AD THAT STANDS UP FOR THE TRUTH")
---
| If you cannot join us in person, please consider doing what you can from afar. I do not need to match the millions that my opponent is spending on lies and attack ads, but I do need to reach voters. We are working smarter, and we have many, many volunteers who really care.

YOU have the power to change the direction of our country, to keep the House of Representatives with a Republican majority.

Now is the time, this is the race.

Please donate online OR by mail to Parrott for Congress, PO Box 32, Funkstown, MD 21734.

Thank you for your encouragement, your support, and your prayers.
For our country,
Neil

Friend, we are on the brink of making history.
On Wednesday night, I attended Kamala Harris’s historic rally on the Ellipse in front of the White House.
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtHtWNDtXR0WReOmqZcCOXOZ5wX0lkemEe2zNMVuYpEPOVgnIy6pn-AzTq8U9mZo9GbEqlkPV_-CnleJuuNOvja-uTN19dvxwGYaIQqjmuXosVhDcYzVYlIMzq0z2DiOujj4VDhgr7UGurft5ylNr-TYKLyhvsrXzR4V_rNYw1yEliaN4XzdQklmImPuKyNlbsssrO8VDj4Xg8sF3MKVeysltlE4YjnzdMnXVmaaoiOoHkwph-iYRfXg3DzuUdXKiIwsbCcpchWkHJJyfHKUUUNcbuI8aoxNLZuAMDW6KZ6zwi2qEPp_7qDRHftqd0jsDZpiUvgeNyF6501Fh-cVFkIFpeNLYcH6SPQ2c6kga4ak6igYVFxmAOF4ClWsFE4UUfPL50sgX3JRq3jPSRxm5ah/4b1/hQJ8fuiJTWCrm07qnbx-tg/h2/h001.gvOv_9znw17EUFCSZ98Uq0q5T-tQVwd3JB7DsCFAMqQ) I felt the surge of inspiration as our next president, Kamala Harris gave a powerful call to action, igniting hope and determination in all who heard it.
She spoke of unity and resilience, reminding us that our fight for justice and equality is far from over. Our democratic ideas are threatened by Donald Trump, who stood in The Ellipse 4 years ago and incited an armed mob to attack the Capitol and overthrow our democracy.
And, she spoke of a caregiving economy - one that lowers the cost of caring for children, seniors, and Americans with disabilities.
**Electing Kamala Harris as president isn’t just an option; it’s a necessity for the future we hope to build. It’s time to make history, to shatter ceilings, and to lead with courage.**

clean_body: | | | She should be our president. Friend, we are on the brink of making history. On Wednesday night, I attended Kamala Harris’s historic rally on the Ellipse in front of the White House. I felt the surge of inspiration as our next president, Kamala Harris gave a powerful call to action, igniting hope and determination in all who heard it. She spoke of unity and resilience, reminding us that our fight for justice and equality is far from over. Our democratic ideas are threatened by Donald Trump, who stood in The Ellipse 4 years ago and incited an armed mob to attack the Capitol and overthrow our democracy. And, she spoke of a caregiving economy - one that lowers the cost of caring for children, seniors, and Americans with disabilities. Electing Kamala Harris as president isn’t just an option; it’s a necessity for the future we hope to build. It’s time to make history, to shatter ceilings, and to lead with courage. | Harris embodies the leadership we need to navigate these challenging times, championing the rights of all individuals and advocating for a brighter future. Last night, alongside 75,000 inspired Americans, I rallied behind Kamala Harris, moved by her visionary leadership and unwavering dedication. Let’s carry this momentum nationwide and make our voices heard at the ballot box! Now, more than ever, your support is crucial. Contributions help amplify our voice and ensure our place at the decision-making table.** Let’s rally together and protect our United States of America! # **RITE Applauds U.S. Supreme Court Ruling Allowing Virginia to Protect Its Elections from Noncitizen Voting **
(Washington, D.C. – October 28, 2024) - Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (“RITE”), a non-profit organization that supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, applauded today’s ruling from the United States Supreme Court declaring that federal law poses no obstacle to the Commonwealth of Virginia removing noncitizens from its voter rolls. [RITE filed an amicus, or “friend of the court,” brief](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=87f3bcacc4&e=ea91f782ea) in support of Virginia’s right to keep its voter rolls free of noncitizens.

Under the leadership of Governor Glenn Youngkin, the Commonwealth of Virginia has worked diligently to remove noncitizens from its voter rolls. The Biden-Harris Department of Justice, along with radical left activist groups, sued Virginia officials to stop these efforts. As RITE argued in its brief filed with the Supreme Court, these lawsuits were based on a gross misreading of federal law and, had they succeeded, would have inflicted grave harm on the people of Virginia by enabling noncitizens to cast ballots in their elections, including the current election for President of the United States. Thankfully, the Supreme Court has put a halt to this misadventure.

“The people of Virginia have every right to insist that the number of non-citizens voting in their elections is zero,” said Derek Lyons, President of RITE. “The federal government’s alliance with far-left activists to compel Virginia to expose its elections to non-citizen participation was an outrageous abuse of authority. Fortunately, the Supreme Court has put a halt to that effort, delivering today a victory for commonsense, public confidence, and election integrity.”

Friend,
Here is one of my core political beliefs...
I believe that every American should have access to the same four freedoms: the freedom to rise, the freedom to learn, the freedom to govern ourselves, and the freedom from violence.
Donald Trump and his acolytes stand for the exact opposite.
Just look at Project 2025, which would give Trump unchecked power to attack our fundamental rights and prosecute political rivals.
With Trump in the White House, Project 2025 would enact a national abortion ban, eliminate the Department of Education, and cut Social Security and Medicare — all to give billionaires more tax breaks.

body:

|
# My Supporters
---
| Much is made in political races about ENDORSEMENTS. As Election Day is fast approaching, many voters will do a quick look at candidates’ websites and make a decision on who to support based on if they “recognize the names” of endorsers. My opponent, who has been in government for over 40 years, easily collects “endorsements” from those who expect something in return when they run for office or look for a government handout.
I would prefer that voters look at my “SUPPORTERS” because it says a lot about what I stand for:
**PARENTAL RIGHTS and PROTECTION OF CHILDREN**
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | Endorsing my campaign is **Erin Friday, Esq.** , a Democrat, attorney, and mom who has relentlessly fought for changes to state law after her child was secretly transitioned at school. (Read more [https://hernandezforcongress.com/blog/the-government-has-gone-too-far](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=493644034a&e=638e6c2751)).
---
| | | | | | | | | | | **State Senator Shannon Grove** has fought hard to protect children in California including SB1414 which passed in the recent session of the California Legislature and was signed into law by the governor. This bill changed the penalty for child sex trafficking from a misdemeanor to a felony.
---
|
---
|
**PUBLIC SAFETY**
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
While my opponent has done nothing to counter the “Defund the Police” and open border terror facilitated by her party, I have a couple new supporters among law enforcement individuals and organizations who are publicly supporting me.
**Ruben Chavez,** formerly San Jose police officer, currently the Chief of Police of Gustine, and **Denise Turner** , the chief of Police of Gilroy both sstrong advocates for public safety and both support my campaign.
---
|
**DEFENSE of MARGINALIZED COMMUNITIES**
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
The support of the **Bay Area Jewish Coalition** is very important to me because I stand firmly behind these communities and support for Israel.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | The Muwekma Ohlone Tribe has been marginalized for years by my opponent. I am proud that Democrat **Charlene Nijmeh, Tribal Chairwomen** of the tribe, and a rival in the Primary Election, endorsed me.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | My own Hispanic Community has been marginalized for decades, seen only as a “reliable” voting block by California politicians. I am excited that faith leaders like **Dr. Sonny and Dr. Linda Lara** (Morgan Hill), have stood up and spread the word that Hispanics need to examine what a candidate stands for and not blindly vote for a person based on their last name.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
Finally, I would be remiss in not highlighting, Carina Powers and the Republican National Hispanic Assembly for their ongoing support.
---
|
I'm humbled by the outpouring of support for my campaign. Please check out my website for other supporters.
Help us get the word out - tell your friends, consider donating to my campaign, vote by November 5th!

---
| Regards,Peter Hernandez
---

Peter, I’ve held many titles throughout my life - including Governor and Senator - but neither of those matter to me as much as these two: **Dad** and **Grandpa**.

As a father of two and a grandfather of seven, my greatest responsibility is fighting for the future of our children and grandchildren. Every day in Washington, I go to battle to ensure the America they inherit is strong, prosperous, and free from the dangerous liberal agenda that seeks to indoctrinate them with radical values. I don’t just fight for my own family—I fight for yours, too.

But now, a radical liberal is working to unseat me and turn America into something we won't recognize. They want to tear down the values we hold dear and impose a socialist, big-government agenda that would weaken our nation and indoctrinate our kids. This fight isn’t just about me—it’s about defending the future for every family in America.

I won’t back down from this battle, but I need your help. My final end-of-month fundraising deadline is TOMORROW, and we’re way behind pace. Meanwhile, my radical opponent is posting 8 figure fundraising hauls. So today, I’m humbly asking if you’ll contribute to my campaign and help me fight back to continue my battle for the future of America.

Sherrod Brown is a fraud, and he’s been a nightmare for our country. We need Bernie, fellow patriot. But we need you with us too. Take a moment to contribute whatever you can below as we close in on the most important Election Day of our lifetime: My father needs Bernie. Ohio needs Bernie. America needs Bernie. Let’s roll! Donald Trump Jr. Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. name: Tucker Carlson
subject: Learn about the Electoral College
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW2M24zWNa

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW2M24zWNa

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear Friend,

Citizens are free to say what they think. Subjects aren't.

Sadly, the question of whether we are citizens or subjects has
become politically controversial in our country. A clear sign of
this is the attempt to suppress the expression of obvious truths,
such as the fact that boys cannot become girls.

Another sign that many of our leaders consider us subjects is
their denial of our right to decide who is allowed to enter our
country-indeed, they tell us that if we complain about mass
illegal immigration, we are racists.

This is a pivotal time in our nation's history-a time when we
must stand up and forthrightly demand to be treated as citizens,
not subjects. Because freedom hangs in the balance.

A poisonous ideology has infected almost every major American
institution. Only a few still stand in defense of freedom and the
right of self-government.

One of the most important of these is Hillsdale College. And
today, my friends at Hillsdale need your partnership and support
in their mission to preserve the blessings of civil and religious
liberty through education.

For 180 years, Hillsdale has offered its students the kind of
education America's founders thought necessary to sustain free
government. And in recent decades, Hillsdale has extended its
teaching mission nationwide with a vast national outreach effort.

This outreach effort includes its free publication Imprimis,
its free online courses, and its tireless work to return
excellence-including excellent civics instruction-to American
K-12 education.

And Hillsdale College does all of this while refusing to accept
one penny of government funding-not even indirectly through
federal or state student grants and loans.

That's why I ask you to take the time to view their video "The
Electoral College Explained" below and join Hillsdale in
defending freedom and the American way of life.

I arose today, joyful and refreshed. In my opinion, Kamala Harris' remarks at the ellipse last evening went to the heart of that final objection that I hear from voters when I knock on doors: the economy.
I think I've mentioned this before to you. I knock. I introduce myself, and I ask, "What's important to you this election?" Frequently, the answer is something along the lines of "taxes", "the economy" or "groceries."
This is what Harris said last night:
> I will make sure you have a chance not just to get by, but to get ahead, because I believe in honoring the dignity of work.
> I will enact the first ever federal ban on price gouging on groceries. I will cap the price of insulin and limit out of pocket prescription costs for all Americans, I will fight to make sure that hard working Americans can actually afford a place to live.
> I'll never forget how our mother saved up and how excited she was when she could finally afford to buy our first home. I remember how excited she was, and I know that pwning a home is not only a measure of financial security, it's about the pride of your hard work, and as President, I will fight to help first time home buyers with your down payment, take on the companies that are jacking up rents and build millions of new homes. For years, we have heard excuses about why America can't build enough housing. Enough with the excuses, I'm going to cut the red tape and work with the private sector and local governments to speed up building and get it done.
> And the cost of housing isn't the only financial pressure on middle class families. I've met so many young people who have a natural desire to parent their children well, but not always the resources to do it. So I'll fight for a child tax credit to save them some money, which will also lift American children out of poverty.
> Our work to lower the cost of childcare, which is out of reach for too many working families today, and for too many people in the sandwich generation who are raising young children and taking care of a parent, juggling all of it is extremely difficult. You know, I took care of my mother when she got sick, cooking foods, food that she had a taste for, finding clothes that would not irritate her skin. And understand, as I do, that caregiving is about dignity. It is about dignity. And currently, if you need home care and you don't have some money to hire someone, you and your family need to deplete your savings to qualify for help, that's just not right, so we're going to change the approach and allow Medicare to cover the cost of home care so seniors can get the help and care they need in their own homes.
> - Kamala Harris, Washington, DC, October 29, 2024
If you haven't already, I encourage you to listen to [Vice President Kamala Harris' interview with Dr. Brene Brown on courageous leadership](https://substack.com/redirect/1d17874d-890a-4c39-8464-4736a2cdfda4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Kamala Harris and Brene Brown are two women who inspire me continuously, so the opportunity to listen to the two of them in a conversation was golden. They spoke of values. One of my favorite lines from Harris during the interview was this: "If you know what to stand for, you know what to fight for."
Said Harris: "I stand for the freedom of women to make decisions about their own body. I stand for the fact that we should treat each other with dignity and respect. I stand for the proposition that we need to lift up working people and give them access to opportunity. These are the kinds of things I stand for. So, I fight for them."
Nothing was said about valuing American citizens over asylum seekers, or those born in Puerto Rico.
Nothing was said about valuing billionaires over middle- and low-income people.
Nothing was said to indicate that Kamala Harris would move our nation towards fascism and away from democracy.
The interview showed that Kamala Harris is a leader who exudes empathy, collaboration, consensus, compassion. Sidebar - did you know that Harris' nickname at Howard University was C-Cubed, short for calm, cool, collected?
Not that other "c" word that was batted about in recent days.
Delivery of the closing remarks on this year's campaign is complicated because so many people have already voted. Early voting is a good thing. But we cannot let up until November 5, 2024, when the last ballot has been cast.
We have now heard and seen Donald Trump's closing remarks at his homage to 1939 rally at Madison Square Garden.
We have now seen and heard Kamala Harris' closing remarks at the ellipse in Washington DC.
I provided remarks at my recent debate against Elise Stefanik. [You may read about that debate here. ](https://substack.com/redirect/caa637ab-4630-4ad5-99e4-78e8132c0707?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)(possible paywall, but I think there may be a free trial period). You can also refer to Ken Tingley's comments on Substack [here](https://open.substack.com/pub/kentingley/p/bonus-failure-to-endorse-another?r=3g6fcu&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web). Also, Ken [wrote about Stefanik today](https://substack.com/redirect/88df17fb-c076-4f11-ac0d-6e636a21c34d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and echoed my concerns about this "list" of political opponents that will be used in the event of a Trump presidency. Stefanik does not push back against any of this, though she masterfully avoids directly quoting the fascist rhetoric.
I closed my debate at The Crandall Library with a call to action. I advised attendees to reach out to their respective support groups in the coming days. Hydrate. Limit the caffeine. Eat properly. Sleep. Exercise. Do whatever it takes to take care of yourself.
I hope I'm wrong, but I think we are in for a long haul between November 5, 2024 and Inauguration Day 2025.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

By Illinois Review

Dear Readers,

Out of respect for all of the hardworking conservative grassroots candidates across the state, Illinois Review has purposefully chosen not to attack Republicans during this General Election cycle.

As a state and country, we are facing the most consequential election in our nation's history – an election not about ideas or policies – but good versus evil and right versus wrong. And attacking Republicans at this time only hurts the top of the ticket with Independent voters and traditional Democrats who no longer recognize their party.

name: George Logan
subject: I just want to apologize, Peter.
body:
I wish from the bottom of my heart I didn’t have to send you this email.

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.email.georgeloganforcongress.com/?qs=236b43198f044258c57d2e811dc4a3eb28101870cbbdacf21a26968108a715806dee064063c8f7523e6a736a4eaeb68c8c6c3246bb0b213f "I want to apologize")
---
Peter -- I just want to apologize.

It is incredibly frustrating that some politicians send you 30 emails a day.

It is wrong that some of these folks try to question your loyalty and guilt you into sending money.

I get how unpleasant this can all be because I get those messages too.

**[I'm George Logan. I'm a son of immigrants, a family man, and proud Afro-Latino Republican.](https://click.email.georgeloganforcongress.com/?qs=236b43198f044258505047c2fa47f5f5909f42ce14f4e7db9cce180d4c2a2c72decec70c3dc9ca9c16ee94e3a0b5a6aef6ce4900530c5659 "I’m George Logan. I’m a son of immigrants, a family man, and proud Afro-Latino Republican.")**

I got fed up with our self-serving politicians in DC and decided to do something about it.

I came within 1% of flipping a seat held by the Socialist Squad in 2022.

They compared me to a monkey and said voters would only support me because I'm Black. **They played dirty and I had to concede. **

I refuse to give up. I'm running again and this time it's a complete TOSS-UP. But the Democrats have over **$280 MILLION** bucks lined up to crush me and every Republican out there.

I wish from the bottom of my heart I didn't have to send you emails at all. I wish I could just leave you alone... but the future of our country is on the line.

I'll be straight up with you, Peter: **[If you chip in today, it will go directly to my campaign allowing me to win the most important House race on the map.](https://click.email.georgeloganforcongress.com/?qs=236b43198f044258327328bcebc35ec6533828dd149b17c708e5bbdcbdb14e0795de55fff48372ebb430e76481b2ec1f01920df55c14f3d5 "If you chip in today, it will go directly to my campaign allowing me to win the most important House race on the map.")**
---

---
If you want to back an Afro-Latino Republican who has every career politician shaking in their boots, **[then I'd be honored to earn your support today.](https://click.email.georgeloganforcongress.com/?qs=236b43198f044258617568e8d31fd01c8c153aa13799266ac8118a67e6de69795602dfebbfc9c3947802b7854b53541fd4281067ae55cc80 "then I’d be honored to earn your support today.")**

If you can't help, I understand that too. Just know I truly appreciate your generosity, prayers and support.

---
THANK YOU!

Keep our ads on the air Keep volunteers our volunteers in the field making calls and knocking on doors Turn out our voters to secure victory! Wisconsin will decide the Senate Majority AND the Presidency. Sincerely, Eric Hovde Republican for U.S. Senate | | MEET ERIC Eric's a fourth-generation Wisconsinite, born and raised in the Madison area. He's a serial entrepreneur. He founded and managed his first business in his twenties and then went on to start and build many others. body:
#

Peter -
When I was in Iraq, in urban combat, we had a special knock we’d use when we were surrounded by insurgents.
The comfort in that knock was knowing that while danger was all around you, the person on the other side of the door was friendly — someone you could depend on.
I’ve never been afraid to ask for help when I needed it. And right now, I’m knocking. I’m coming to you for help, Peter.
Kari Lake is on the offense. With just a few days until voting ends, she has a resource advantage over us. She’s got more money to spend, and she is funneling all of it into a massive surge. body:
Given that Jon Tester won his first race in 2006 by just 3,562 votes, every vote matters. | [](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=1a7b335e5b5e4a4e80a6275c2e1d2467&_e=aWjqsPLnkzhVpYdWMT_1A6ymuZ2x31EJTBxQtJ-1Prrqo2Gcg2uiILjzTsDCB7LNWLsIumeRrtM0jLoQL7NZDq4HOvQuXpMkZ4OJ8OUQnWRulMBudX42PWXC1p1xsExf_dUbCL7TQFfZYHxPYZbZW1aF0NzPLpWP_9Xxs8tBaGStKZ8Y29N0B-NarRGINRcTh48Z5JkWm1Uu5iu1DkL59zWzP9aQarUjzS34tZ15FUnNpMZvhuYZnOf2TXk6SSTw9OEcNX0zquUw0uhJWyQFwphBW57_7GNseAVBIJTnX8sQk8Ai4IT-ig7qwa3-1iB7WMLyF1Dxr9vL22MrhXntuq3yHsaXP7sqgM5weL2rG_LGAYd7DFMNWdtIBhQw6DJIuzBDQ22JC3mqo8LbChWiyZQ_8WmT7zqRNnNUDQiqjtE%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

If the most recent poll released over the weekend is to be believed, more than 23,000 voters in Montana have yet to decide whether they will support me or my opponent, Democrat Jon Tester.

body:
| _Tammy Baldwin here — I wanted to make sure you saw this message from Jon Tester's team. Jon is running for reelection in Montana to defend our Democratic Senate majority, so I hope you'll read this message and[chip in if you can.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-tester.Z0aSwr&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241030_PM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=4370%2E35263%2E2FCKud)_
* * *
Peter—it’s Shelbi, Jon Tester’s Campaign Manager. I just made a tough decision that you need to hear about immediately. **According to several recent reports, Tim Sheehy lied about his military service.**
1. On the campaign trail, Sheehy claimed he had a gunshot wound in his arm from combat. But according to the **_New York Times_** , public records, and firsthand accounts—including a Navy SEAL who served with Sheehy—his gunshot wound was from accidentally shooting himself in the arm in Glacier National Park.
2. Days later, **_NBC News_** released another bombshell report stating Sheehy lied about being “medically discharged” from the Navy.

It’s shocking—and Montanans must know the truth but we’re running out of time. So I made the difficult decision to launch more television and digital ads today. name: Kelly Morrison
subject: October Recap
body:
https://kellyforcongress.org [https://kellyforcongress.org]
Hi Peter!
I hope you’re well. It is hard to believe that we are less than one week away from Election Day. The past year on the campaign trail has been a wonderful whirlwind, and I am so grateful to everyone I have had the honor of meeting and working with throughout this process.
As we are closing out this last full month of the campaign, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on October. But before we dive in, I do need to ask for your help. Peter, we have a goal of raising $100k by Election Day, and we could use your support in getting us there.

Despite no evidence of widespread fraud and millions of taxpayer dollars wasted investigating false claims, a relative few cases and convictions have happened, despite the avalanche of voter suppression legislation passed since 2017 . Yet these opponents of voting rights continue to spread lies and misinformation. Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.
That’s why I’m personally asking you to join my reelection team and split $10 between Jay Jones and my campaign today to help us defend Montana’s Senate seat. Anything you can give makes a difference. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_fr_tester?amount=10]

Peter, What do you do when you’re in enemy territory, outnumbered, and outgunned, with no backup in sight? You don’t panic. You don’t hesitate. You LEAD. In my new book **_Hard Truths: Think and Lead Like a Green Beret_** , I take you behind the scenes of life-or-death moments on the battlefield where every decision mattered. I’ll show you the times when quick thinking, adaptability, and boldness turned near disasters into victories. These aren’t just war stories. They’re lessons on leadership that can be applied to any challenge—whether you’re in the boardroom, the battlefield, or the daily grind of life. Leadership is tested in the hardest moments, but it’s also built there. **[**Within you, there is a great leader waiting to be unleashed. Order your copy of _Hard Truths_ today and become the STRONGEST version of yourself!**](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=507948dd2e0c4cbba9077d12f39f304c&_e=exsqzB45RXAngNyCBaPVrcI0fq1x5x6MKHnmNZHZsIXD8s8gxkCzuJlZPYZMqW9ztxgr7rl1RwAN6A13VOMmV1BdB73rs3SLf1CWNhabEft7_pi-_v_BajqE3Ckint7iJOqZdc-8Ol8nXGdua9BVf0NJTnEQGNl16heOO7LTkUZwAVMlrHDItV_ezo4k_BBvqh7bU3JOPlKvzTi7zPgveiOGh_OQoVc1tuDzG2c3TwczkBgCXU_7i75tib1iMSDJkF22Az74dCD28Gk6jq43G53DRDYJ1U67lKq3h3tm38PQBbkJmeaLHvMM1ooUEpsVdhAmlGgdy-tObV8PvzZ_aChdEuliFla2KONf1TMoc4wd-peALp7S8OblFVa3FG5M)**

subject: I’m much more than just a basketball player...
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
body:
Allow me to introduce myself to you
|
---

Fellow American,

You may already know who I am from my basketball career. Or, maybe you're just hearing about me for the first time through my Senate Campaign. Either way, I wanted to formally introduce myself and share my story. [**_Afterward, I 'm going to ask you to send a small contribution to my campaign as I continue to fight to Flip the Senate Red._**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=c60a666213b640b6b399bb8c718bb46d&_e=fo20yLI9oq4RS6cVRv_MS5HxAUv3BR4aqZchDaniDLYoC42n99GMQvpz2YEE2Afx7nGDFjPuMxkXPgamJcv0LK-6-uRq5uDieLWqYL60sj5oWDdSgKD2J10mXZDCyGIkLJ6NC7Lq-DLSVElX62OqtLMMjrePiyHN8toISUFGvVvi68UwmHRb5Q-4MZL7DKMK9gR8aFaPfvNsdLpyEkWIH8dJvgsF3nyUWnToZOf2MjCjBiiQ_fty22IGX2d_0o5bQWOhQ6i6yDyLnjirjI389bFplJpu7kSBqybunVpbUj1ZLnZa2eCSk8PkUXKGn3u1DWpHEb6xIuIVAXYx1dOZiQ%3D%3D)

I was born and raised in the Twin Cities in Minnesota, mainly in the Rondo Community of St. Paul. At the age of five, I started playing sports, and at nine years old, I was already playing basketball on the Northside of Minneapolis. My mother was a single mother who worked tirelessly to give me a better life. I went to school in Rondo and began to excel at basketball. By 10th grade, I was ranked as a top 20 player in the country. I remember dreaming of reaching the NBA one day- a dream shared by millions of kids.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=c60a666213b640b6b399bb8c718bb46d&_e=fo20yLI9oq4RS6cVRv_MS5HxAUv3BR4aqZchDaniDLYoC42n99GMQvpz2YEE2Afx7nGDFjPuMxkXPgamJcv0LK-6-uRq5uDieLWqYL60sj5oWDdSgKD2J10mXZDCyGIkLJ6NC7Lq-DLSVElX62OqtLMMjrePiyHN8toISUFGvVvi68UwmHRb5Q-4MZL7DKMKVVSzXPUqZECoPlI2LiasK0naQ57zKPXyw7bHLrn_edI1myEBwvq4SgDlWzdNGJqsX7joVvpJcqCkO3Aqyup4LVtO7eRuXxARqKdzFG7m5xKTGWIA7MfcWHfaXDey_Tu4xcnTyKyR2bsOWCby9xqESA%3D%3D)
I accepted a scholarship at the University of Minnesota, but shortly after transferred to Iowa State. There, I won multiple basketball awards while working hard in class and being named on the Dean's List for academics.

Friend, Just six days. That’s all the time left in our campaign to bring much-needed change to the North Coast’s representation in the U.S. Congress. I have good news and one ask. The good news: Republicans are disproportionately voting early compared to Democrats. **We are doing a better job than my opponent of getting our voters to return their ballots!** Here’s my ask: Can you call 5 of your friends in the district and get them to go vote? Help me reach late and undecided voters with the facts about my opponent’s failed leadership for the past decade! Right now, we are running commercials throughout the North Coast and going door-to-door, reminding Republicans and Independents to vote by November 5th. [Can you contribute to our last-minute Get-Out-The-Vote fund?](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BQHN8dj0075RPS2ZEaqlW6KBx1jwPUXwWcNKXyHK-fEnzhDwcVaAcKBv2cKMn_Rhzwk-T7vw9ztJkESY6QMTPq6&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=republicans_are_winning_early&n=2) [**DONATE NOW »**](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BQHN8dj0075RPS2ZEaqlW6KBx1jwPUXwWcNKXyHK-fEnzhDwcVaAcKBv2cKMn_Rhzwk-T7vw9ztJkESY6QMTPq6&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=republicans_are_winning_early&n=3) We’re talking to voters about my plan to protect our water and agriculture resources, secure the border, and revitalize our small businesses. And here’s a key number:**there are still 150,000 Republicans and “no party preference” voters in the 2nd Congressional District who have not yet voted.** Getting as many of them as possible to vote early will make a huge difference. [Help us raise the last-minute funds we need to reach these voters in this final week of the election.](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BQHN8dj0075RPS2ZEaqlW6KBx1jwPUXwWcNKXyHK-fEnzhDwcVaAcKBv2cKMn_Rhzwk-T7vw9ztJkESY6QMTPq6&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=republicans_are_winning_early&n=4) Thank you for your continued support throughout this incredible campaign. Latino Influence on TikTok and Beyond:
Carlos Eduardo Espina and PBS Filmmakers Discuss Diversity, Stories, and Social Media's Role
The Latino Vote Podcast Episode 60
| Chuck and Mike sit down with **Carlos Eduardo Espina** , a social media influencer and advocate, alongside a team of filmmakers behind the **PBS documentary "Voces: Latino Vote 2024"**.

Carlos shares his journey from an aspiring political science student to a leading Latino voice on TikTok for Latino advocacy amassing millions of followers along the way. Meanwhile, the filmmakers discuss their mission to authentically represent the multifaceted Latino experience, emphasizing that Latinos are the second-largest voting demographic yet often remain misunderstood. Whether you're a digital strategist, an activist, or just curious about Latino voter perspectives, this episode has something for everyone.

Look, I REALLY don't want to have to tell Sherrod we fell short – not with Trump, McConnell, and the entire Republican party going ALL IN to defeat him and flip the Senate red. We were already outspent 3-to-1, and the latest polls show us down, so if we don't turn this around ASAP, it could cost us this race. So here's the deal: I approved a massive GOTV push this weekend, but we can't pay for it unless we reach this end-of-month goal. So, I'm counting on this grassroots team to chip in $5 to help us get there. Here's the best link to rush your support:= Thanks a bunch, Rachel Campaign Manager | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Friends of Sherrod Brown 605 N. subject: The fate of our Democratic Senate majority hinges on Montana

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241030em-kenburns [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241030em-kenburns]
Hello there, it's Ken Burns.
I’ve dedicated my life to telling America’s stories through film. Oftentimes, those stories aren’t easy. They examine moments of our country in crisis and threats to our democracy.
So, I can confidently say our country is at a crossroads, and this is the most consequential election of our lives. We are the stewards of our republic, and now more than ever, our democratic values are at stake.
That’s why I’m reaching out today. The fate of our Democratic Senate majority—and all the progress that comes with it—hinges on Jon Tester and what happens in Montana.
Will you please join me in supporting Jon’s campaign during this critical moment by making a split donation today? I’m not exaggerating when I say the stakes have never been higher. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241030em-kenburns]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241030em-kenburns]
Having spent almost five decades making films that tell America’s stories, I am well-versed in our country’s historic moments.
Despite troubling times, Americans have always met challenging moments with fierce hope and determination to preserve a future that safeguards our democracy, respects our rights, and upholds our most cherished value of freedom.
This year’s election is another challenge for us to meet: In Montana’s Senate race, Jon Tester is running against Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate.
This race will come down to a handful of votes, and Republicans are pouring millions in an effort to flip Montana’s Senate seat.
I believe we need a leader like Jon Tester in the Senate. So I’m asking you to dig deep and make a split donation to help build the resources Jon needs to fight back against the GOP’s attacks and win this critical election. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241030em-kenburns]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241030em-kenburns]
This is important.
Thank you,
Ken Burns

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
October 30, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**ICYMI: Terra Lawson-Remer’s Vote for Mileage Tax Sparks Backlash in San Diego County**
The latest [San Diego News Desk article](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=9c24a99525&e=784f78234b) reveals Terra Lawson-Remer's backing of a widely opposed mileage tax in the 2021 Regional Transportation Plan—a tax so damaging to working families that it was ultimately defeated, despite her support. Her consistent alignment with policies that hurt constituents highlights how out of touch she is with her district, especially as inflation cuts into family budgets. This November, voters have a chance to choose a representative who will not only show up but fight for every constituent— and that's Kevin Faulconer.
—
[**SD NEWS DESK: Terra Lawson-Remer’s Vote for Mileage Tax Sparks Backlash in San Diego County**](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=831cfc3e5d&e=784f78234b)
San Diego County Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer has long been criticized for her lenient stance on crime, a record that has come under increasing scrutiny as California grapples with a rise in smash-and-grab robberies, homelessness, and violent crime. Despite widespread support from both sides of the aisle for Prop 36, a measure that would put an end to rampant smash-and-grab robberies across the state, Lawson-Remer has refused to support the initiative. Prop 36, backed by a broad bipartisan coalition and more than a million signatures from voters across California, aims to restore accountability by addressing the surge in theft crimes that has paralyzed businesses and put community safety at risk.
Prop 36’s momentum has been driven by California residents’ frustration with the rise of crime. The initiative is not just about increased penalties but also about giving judges the ability to offer treatment programs for those struggling with addiction or mental health issues, something that Lawson-Remer claims to support. Yet, her refusal to back this widely supported measure leaves many questioning whether she truly prioritizes public safety.
This is not the first time Lawson-Remer has been at odds with common-sense criminal justice reforms. In 2021, she openly advocated for the privacy rights of violent sexual predators going so far as to oppose California Senate Bill 248, which required hearings for sexually violent predators to be open to the public. SB248 was designed to ensure transparency in the judicial process and give communities the ability to understand who was being considered for release back into their neighborhoods. Lawson-Remer called the bill “redundant” and argued for “flexibility” to protect the privacy of offenders in treatment options, a stance that put her squarely at odds with community members and victims’ rights advocates.
Her opposition to SB 248 was met with outrage from concerned parents and public safety advocates. Many pointed out that while protecting the privacy of violent sexual predators, Lawson-Remer failed to consider the safety and well-being of the communities where these predators could return. Critics argue that her position reflects a dangerous pattern—prioritizing the rights of criminals over the safety and security of law-abiding citizens.
In addition to her stance on sexual predators, Lawson-Remer’s record includes other decisions that raised eyebrows among voters concerned with public safety. In January 2021, she voted to support a controversial needle exchange program aimed at reducing health risks for intravenous drug users.
According to The San Diego Union-Tribune on January 27, 2021, “County supervisors on Tuesday agreed to create a needle exchange program as part of a strategy to reduce health risks for intravenous drug users.” While proponents argue that such programs reduce the spread of diseases like HIV, critics contend that these programs enable drug addiction and undermine efforts to reduce drug use and crime. One supervisor who voted against the program pointed out, “Giving out needles still has the appearance of promoting drug abuse,” stating he would rather see more efforts toward drug abuse prevention.
The need for effective drug addiction treatment is dire, especially in light of the alarming statistics showing 6,928 emergency room visits for drug overdoses in San Diego County in 2021. Yet, the county only has 70 drug addiction beds under contract, none of which are located within the city of San Diego. This glaring lack of resources underscores the inadequacy of Lawson-Remer’s approach to addressing the drug crisis.
With her track record, it’s no wonder that Lawson-Remer’s failure to support Prop 36 is seen as more of the same. Her history of leniency and prioritizing offenders’ privacy over public safety is out of step with the needs of San Diego County residents, who are growing increasingly concerned about rising crime rates and the lack of accountability for repeat offenders.
As the election season heats up, voters will be looking closely at Lawson-Remer’s record, and her consistent opposition to measures that would hold criminals accountable may well be a deciding factor. These questions remain: Is Lawson-Remer truly interested in protecting her constituents, or is she more concerned with defending the rights of those who harm them?—

Every 80 seconds, a preborn child loses its life at the hands of Planned Parenthood. This means that by the time you finish reading this email, another innocent life will be gone.

Alarmingly, they perform 62 abortions for every prenatal care service they provide, and prenatal care services are down 80% since 2010.

As a pro-life individual, I know you don't want your hard-earned tax dollars to support an organization that prioritizes abortion.

That's why I'm urging you to join us to demand an end to this taxpayer-funded ongoing tragedy. A new Congress and president will be chosen this November, and they need to hear from us _now_ that America does NOT support funding Planned Parenthood.

Make your voice heard. | | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

[](https://king4ut.us/l/U4BSkwDUfY33)

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

**Prefer to donate via mail? Address a check to:**

Salt Lake City, UT 84158

# [My dad went to last night's Trump rally.
