Donald Trump was in Allentown, Pennsylvania last night, where, some of you may know, I was born and partly raised. (My parents were divorced and I split my time between there and the Eastern Shore of Maryland.) My dad, George, is now retired, after spending three-plus decades in the Allentown School District as a psychologist. He's no fan of Trump, but decided to check out the rally, and he emailed a dispatch to our family this morning. I thought it was a perspective you'd find interesting and asked if I could send it out to my newsletter readers, and he agreed. I think even the Trump supporters on this list will find it worth the read. Stick around for the last paragraph, which starts, "As a final note, I must give the old guy props..."
### A View from Inside the Belly of the Beast, Observations from a Psychologist with Trump Derangement Syndrome at a Trump Rally
by George Grim
A few pictures are worth a thousand words. The attached video [below] from the Trump rally in Allentown yesterday shows the love and energy that these people have for their hero/savior/god. As I scanned the crowd, I had an instant reaction that their outstretched arms were a Nazi salute, but that has been replaced by the ubiquitous cell phone. The Lee Greenwood anthem is spiritually adored by his inspired legions of "real" Americans. Prior to his arrival, the arena was filled with ear splitting sounds from other artists, which made me wonder why there were still some artists allowing him to use their songs. I had to roll up wads of napkin to protect my ears and it made conversation with others very difficult.
As we waited to get into the event, I was able to pursue one of my main goals...asking Trumpers why they support him. I started my first conversation with a flag-waver by saying, "I'm on the fence about this guy, can you tell me why you support him?" Subsequently I dropped the pretense of neutrality and just approached by saying "What are your top reasons for supporting Trump?" It may sound unfair to characterize my new friends as low information voters but if you add highly misinformed voters, you get a fuller picture. Particularly interesting to me was my discussion with 3 college age guys. They were very willing to indulge this elderly white guy. One of them started by noting he lives in Easton and the immigrants are a huge problem. I wished I had more time for that issue and to examine my own bias in assuming he is prejudiced.
As the topics of the economy and Trump's leadership arose, I found myself reverting to my teaching days. For the leadership issue I asked for a reaction to the grab-them-by-the-XXXXX comment. His response was that all guys say things they regret at some point but I'm more concerned with someone being a good leader. It was tough to move past that one. Their way of ending my lecture was to stick out a hand and thank me for a conversation among reasonable people. I accepted that with my unbridled optimism that maybe I got them to pause and think.
Being in the crowd and observing reactions only gives me pessimism that there was anyone who would be changing their mind. This crowd was not there for any policy view. No matter what Trump said, it was either a loud cheer or loud boo. At one point Trump was talking about the estate tax and when he concluded with the wrong statement that Kamala wanted to get rid of it, they still cheered.
If you'll note the picture of the woman 2 seats from me, she was especially welcoming and friendly. She found the woman seated next to me in the parking lot and because that woman was alone, she took her under her wing or whatever, and ushered her to join her.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ac709936-2004-48c6-9813-7cef82524344?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As probably a fair generalization, the people were very nice to everyone. (I wore a red Phillies hat and tried not to stand out.) But I was taken aback when Trump mentioned Kamala, this friendly woman yelled, "Whore!" So on the surface it was a lovefest with a sense that you were among friends and could enjoy a concert-like atmosphere with people you have bonded with. But there was also an ugliness to the opposition as Trump portrayed his usual suspects in quite hateful language. They were quick to get into their chants of "Fight Fight Fight." "Lock Her Up." and "USA USA USA" When Trump described the crowd as feisty, they got quite fired up!
If you read about the event, it was obvious to me that the campaign was playing damage control. Allentown has a large Puerto Rican community and 3 or 4 speakers were Republicans who tried to portray Trump as a great friend to PR. I could only laugh to myself as Marco Rubio praised Trump and emphasized his interest in diversity and joy and how hateful Harris's campaign is. Curiously, I would not call it a diverse crowd, especially in a majority Hispanic city.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9cf7e607-68c3-4bbc-814e-a67843ee865d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I don't want to get too far into the weeds of my disagreements with Trump, but I'll highlight one issue that burns my britches. He bragged about his effect on the media. He made some claim that when he started the media had something like a 92% approval rating and now it's down to 12%. The actual numbers are certainly in that direction, his exaggerations notwithstanding. My question is, "Where do we go from here?" These people are convinced that anything he says is true and anything the opposition (Mainstream media, etc.) says is false. My best hope is that Trump is soundly defeated, guardrails hold and there is not another Trump-in-waiting demigod with his charisma.
As a final note, I must give the old guy props. We have seen many recent examples of his declining mental faculties. For this event he showed few major issues, probably related to staying with the teleprompter. He is an entertainer and knows his crowd. He had sufficient energy and did not slur his words. He puts on a good show for his admirers and just as he played the role of a successful businessman on the Apprentice, he can play the role of a successful politician in this type of event.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f1b76747-107b-4e65-aa35-cdfb92eacdd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

As we waited to get into the event, I was able to pursue one of my main goals...asking Trumpers why they support him. I started my first conversation with a flag-waver by saying, "I'm on the fence about this guy, can you tell me why you support him?" Subsequently I dropped the pretense of neutrality and just approached by saying "What are your top reasons for supporting Trump?" It may sound unfair to characterize my new friends as low information voters but if you add highly misinformed voters, you get a fuller picture. Particularly interesting to me was my discussion with 3 college age guys. They were very willing to indulge this elderly white guy. One of them started by noting he lives in Easton and the immigrants are a huge problem. I wished I had more time for that issue and to examine my own bias in assuming he is prejudiced. As the topics of the economy and Trump's leadership arose, I found myself reverting to my teaching days. For the leadership issue I asked for a reaction to the grab-them-by-the-XXXXX comment. His response was that all guys say things they regret at some point but I'm more concerned with someone being a good leader. It was tough to move past that one. Their way of ending my lecture was to stick out a hand and thank me for a conversation among reasonable people. I accepted that with my unbridled optimism that maybe I got them to pause and think. Being in the crowd and observing reactions only gives me pessimism that there was anyone who would be changing their mind. This crowd was not there for any policy view. No matter what Trump said, it was either a loud cheer or loud boo. At one point Trump was talking about the estate tax and when he concluded with the wrong statement that Kamala wanted to get rid of it, they still cheered. If you'll note the picture of the woman 2 seats from me, she was especially welcoming and friendly. She found the woman seated next to me in the parking lot and because that woman was alone, she took her under her wing or whatever, and ushered her to join her. | | ---|---|--- As probably a fair generalization, the people were very nice to everyone. (I wore a red Phillies hat and tried not to stand out.) But I was taken aback when Trump mentioned Kamala, this friendly woman yelled, "Whore!" So on the surface it was a lovefest with a sense that you were among friends and could enjoy a concert-like atmosphere with people you have bonded with. But there was also an ugliness to the opposition as Trump portrayed his usual suspects in quite hateful language. They were quick to get into their chants of "Fight Fight Fight." "Lock Her Up." and "USA USA USA" When Trump described the crowd as feisty, they got quite fired up! If you read about the event, it was obvious to me that the campaign was playing damage control. Allentown has a large Puerto Rican community and 3 or 4 speakers were Republicans who tried to portray Trump as a great friend to PR. I could only laugh to myself as Marco Rubio praised Trump and emphasized his interest in diversity and joy and how hateful Harris's campaign is. Curiously, I would not call it a diverse crowd, especially in a majority Hispanic city. | | ---|---|--- I don't want to get too far into the weeds of my disagreements with Trump, but I'll highlight one issue that burns my britches. He bragged about his effect on the media. He made some claim that when he started the media had something like a 92% approval rating and now it's down to 12%. The actual numbers are certainly in that direction, his exaggerations notwithstanding. My question is, "Where do we go from here?" These people are convinced that anything he says is true and anything the opposition (Mainstream media, etc.) says is false. My best hope is that Trump is soundly defeated, guardrails hold and there is not another Trump-in-waiting demigod with his charisma. As a final note, I must give the old guy props. We have seen many recent examples of his declining mental faculties. For this event he showed few major issues, probably related to staying with the teleprompter. He is an entertainer and knows his crowd. He had sufficient energy and did not slur his words. He puts on a good show for his admirers and just as he played the role of a successful businessman on the Apprentice, he can play the role of a successful politician in this type of event. This is my personal newsletter. To get my work at Drop Site News, | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Ryan Grim 1701 Pennsylvania Ave. NW/Washington, DC 20016 ? ?

| | Fellow American, I got a few free minutes today, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped into this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-party state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates. But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in _burning_ our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. This is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help, we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S. **The last end of month deadline before Election Day is right around the corner.** We outraised Adam Schiff in past months but Kamala Harris’ nomination as the Democrat’s candidate for president has energized their grassroots supporters and donors. If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians, and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We **need** to show our strength this month. Peter, it’s Mark Kelly.
I try not to pay much attention to polls, especially when there’s still so much work to do.
But there are some moments you need to stand up and pay attention to, and yesterday was one of them.
**Not one, but two polls were released in Arizona that showed Ruben within one point of his opponent, Kari Lake.** One had Kari Lake slightly ahead, the other had Ruben slightly ahead.
Whatever way you look at it, I can tell you from experience: With less than a week until the election, you’d much rather be leading those polls.
Ruben can win this race. I believe that. But the way he’s going to do it isn’t by worrying or looking for more polls that show the race moving in our direction. The way he’ll win is by raising the resources it’s going to take to reach every single undecided voter, everyone who hasn’t turned in their ballot yet.
This isn’t rocket science. If we get to those people and convince them to vote for Ruben, we win this race. Can I count on you to help fuel our efforts?

"Why are you still asking me for money?" is probably 1 of the top 5 questions I get right now. (The others usually involve asking for more supplies for our field offices or what's on Ashley's schedule.) There are 2 reasons we're still fundraising, teammate:
1. **We made ad buys and other big purchases based on what we projected we'd raise.** See, the earlier we book things like TV spots, the cheaper it is. BUT, we make those buys based on projections the Finance Team puts together on what they expect we will raise. If we don't hit our goals, we either have to make cuts or go into debt.
2. **There are always last-minute expenses that come up.** Sometimes a box of flyers for a field office gets wrecked, people's yard signs get stolen, or a surge of volunteers means we need more supplies for an office. If there's one thing I know about campaigns, it's to expect the unexpected. And usually dealing with the unexpected requires money.

Hey team,

Eternal vigilance is how we protect the rights of the people—and we know freedom is in peril across the land as **the Supreme Court itself participates in the right-wing destruction of liberty.**

But Maryland has been a **beacon of hope in the fight for reproductive freedom and health care** , and **it’s time for us to act boldly again to fortify our freedom**.

Abortion is lawful here today, but it’s not a protected fundamental right. _**That’s why this November, we have a historic opportunity to change that by voting YES on Question 1 and enshrining reproductive freedom as a fundamental right in Maryland’s state Constitution.**_ This is about much more than just one election—it’s about safeguarding the right of every Marylander to make their own healthcare decisions without government interference—forever.

**With powerful opposition mobilizing against us, we can’t afford to take the fundamental freedoms of women and men for granted.** The stakes are high, and the outcome of this vote will resonate for generations to come.

I’ve dedicated my life to defending our rights, and I know that no one person can do this alone. **We need everyone in this fight.** Every dollar you contribute to Freedom in Reproduction Maryland will go directly toward educating voters to ensure that our voices are heard loud and clear across Maryland on Election Day.

subject: Tennesseans are not voting, and we MUST get them to the polls
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tennessee House Democratic Caucus | Ronnie Glynn, Treasurer
body:
https://tnhousedems.com/ [https://tnhousedems.com/]
Peter,
Here at the Tennessee House Democratic Caucus we are following early voting numbers closely. Sadly, with democracy on the line and a supermajority holding our state hostage, Tennesseans are still not voting in key House districts. We simply have to get the voters who share our values to the polls if we want to have any chance of winning.
This requires even more investment in media buys and effective GOTV tools. At this moment, less than one week out from Election Day, the direct correlation between dollars spent and voter turnout is strongest.
DONATE HERE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dems24]
Of course, Republicans know this too, and that is why they invested tens of thousands in more television ads last night in targeted districts where we are neck and neck.
We MUST match them dollar for dollar. After two years of hard work and keeping pace with Republican spending for the first time in decades, we cannot allow these crucial House seats to slip through our fingers in the last six days.
DONATE HERE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dems24]
So, I’m personally asking you: please step up and contribute anything you can today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dems24] Let’s wipe those smug grins off their faces on election night with some key Democratic victories and send a clear signal of strong Democratic momentum in Tennessee.
Thank you for being with us when it matters most.
With sincere gratitude,
John Ray Clemmons

Blueberry bread is important here in my Washington, D.C. office and I’ll explain why. **[_But first, with only 6 days until the most important election of our lifetime, can you chip in $10 towards my campaign and my colleague Jeanne Shaheen?_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96182819/509164287/425031687?&amounts=10,25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk3022-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODk1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODNiZjQzZS1mYTk2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P5HHc06Zc4sncOvw2Jupt3dKBKV-9aw6lWacRcpHNMc=)**
At 9 AM on just about every Wednesday when the Senate is in session, we serve coffee and the best blueberry bread you could imagine to any and all Mainers who are visiting the Capitol.
We even have a map of Maine in the office with pins for each hometown because people come from all over for blueberry bread Wednesdays! People visit D.C. for all kinds of reasons – from conferences to sightseeing – but no matter why they’re visiting I’m happy to provide them with a little taste of Maine hundreds of miles from home. And the best part? Getting to chat with fellow Mainers and hear their stories.
We’re living in divisive times, friend. Now more than ever we need opportunities like this to bring us together. And, as an Independent in Congress, bringing people together is what I aim to do every day.
**[Friend: While I’d love to put all of my energy into blueberry bread and my work in Congress, I also have to raise money for my reelection campaign. And with just DAYS left until Election Day, it’s critical we don’t fall behind. Choice and democracy are on the ballot and I want to keep fighting for YOU in the Senate. Friend: As the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, I was raised to fight hard, do what’s right, and make the change I want to see.
That's what pushed me through waiting tables at Caesars Palace to help pay for college, becoming the first in my family to graduate, and working as a computer programmer in a male-dominated field.
It's what motivated me during my first-ever campaign for Congress in 2016, when I flipped a highly competitive district from red to blue. And in my campaign for Senate in 2018, when I defeated a Republican incumbent against all odds – becoming the second woman senator in Nevada's history.
It's why you can _always_ count on me to advocate for working families and bring much-needed progress to the lives of all Nevadans. **But right now, I'm facing the fight of my life – and I need your help.**
**National Republicans and dark money groups are spending $75 MILLION to unseat me and flip Nevada red. # HELP US GET OUT THE VOTE!
---
| We are less than one week from Election Day!
Turnout is critical, and we need your help! We are knocking on doors, waving signs, and making phone calls to encourage voters to turn in their ballots. Read on to learn more...
_(If you are outside Spokane, we can either connect you with your local GOP - or we can send you a list of addresses for doors to knock on, or a list of phone numbers to call with a script...email Erich_[ _here_](mailto:erich@votebaumgartner.com?subject=&body=) _)_

---
|
# KNOCKING ON DOORS
---
| **Super-Duper Saturday!**
This Saturday, Nov 2, we’ll be rallying at the Lower Manito Park picnic shelter in Spokane at 9.30 am.
Come hear from Michael and the other great Republican candidates, and then help us track down every last ballot in Spokane County to ensure everyone’s voice is heard on Election Day!

---
|
You can also join the Spokane GOP and other great Republican volunteers for “doorbelling” by showing up at the locations below.
Upcoming dates are:
* **Thursday, October 31, from 9-11 am**
Meet at Maple Street Bistro, 5520 N. Maple St. in Spokane
* **Friday, November 1, from 9-11 am**
Meet at Galaxy Grind, 12402 E. Saltese Rd. in Spokane Valley
* **SUPER-DUPER SATURDAY, November 2, from 9:30 am-12 pm**
Meet at Manito Park’s lower picnic shelter, 1702 S. Grand Blvd. in Spokane
(Candidates will be attending and this will be a big push with ballot strategies)
* **Sunday, November 3, from 1-3 pm**
Meet at Maple Street Bistro, 5520 N. Maple St. in Spokane
* **Monday, November 4, from 4-6 pm**
Meet at Little Garden Cafe, 2901 W. Northwest Blvd. in Spokane
* **Tuesday, November 5, from 9-11 am**
Meet at Little Garden Cafe, 2901 W. Northwest Blvd. in Spokane

---
|
---
| **SIGN WAVING****** Team Baumgartner is meeting at busy intersections every weekday morning and afternoon from now through November 5th, and _YOU SHOULD BE HERE WITH US!_ Click the button below, bundle up and join us in reminding folks to get their ballots turned in on time! (Contact [Erich](mailto:erich@votebaumgartner.com?subject=&body=) if you need more specific directions).
**Wednesday, October 30 (TODAY!)
**_**Afternoon:**_ Monroe & Broadway from 4:30-5:30 pm
**Thursday, October 31
** _**Morning:**_**** Monroe & Summit Parkway from 7:30-8:30 am _**Afternoon:**_**** Division & Mission from 4:30-5:30 pm
**Friday, November 1
** _**Morning:**_**** Centennial Trail overpass on Hamilton from 7:30-8:30 am _**Afternoon:**_**** 37th & Regal from 4:30-5:30 pm
**Monday, November 4
** _**Morning:**_**** I-90 overpass at Regal from 7:30-8:30 am _**Afternoon:**_ “Maple Street Gap” between Broadway & Summit Parkway from 4:30-5:30 pm
**Tuesday, November 5 (ELECTION DAY!)
**_**Morning:**_ Lincoln Statue in downtown Spokane (Lincoln/Main Ave) from 7:30-8:30 am
---

|
---
| **PHONE BANKING**
Phone banking can be done in the comfort of your own home! If you can spare some time, we need as many volunteers as we can get to make phone calls reminding voters of the November 5th deadline. Please send an email to [erich@votebaumgartner.com](mailto:erich@votebaumgartner.com?subject=&body=) to learn how to do it from home. We'll get you a list of names and numbers, along with a script to make it easy!

Team, **"I have to get it done before the election, because I don’t know what’s going to happen after the election."** That's what one of my patients told me earlier this month when she came in to get her IUD replaced. She was nervous about the pain (if men could get IUDs, it'd be standard to get anesthesia before the procedure). But when I suggested we reschedule for a later time when she could get medication to help with her anxiety, she refused to wait.

**That's the impact of Trump's abortion bans and MAGA's new threats to go after birth control.**

Women are making health care decisions not based on what's best for them physically and emotionally, but out of fear that their personal health care decisions will get them thrown in jail. As their doctor, it makes me furious.

It's why I threw my stethoscope in the ring to represent the people of Northeast Wisconsin.

**The only OB/GYNs in Congress right now are 2 anti-choice Republican men — there's never been a woman. It's so clear how desperately needed that perspective is.**

Citizens are free to say what they think. Subjects aren’t.

| | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=629bad775c9641b780ab80f7bdd26c7c&_t=pnK-UD6SlT_0GnpUXll0vM9qCy4hsbKfoMpjqKunPd26uRNM2qM2UEP9019ZedJBBYvL34aBRhrQYt63YOHLfdBAdHpN56i3QWvDywXb8RkPDl_-gNkfMQ5r4kNpthwG)_

| | Dear Friend,

Citizens are free to say what they think. Subjects aren't.

Sadly, the question of whether we are citizens or subjects has become politically controversial in our country. A clear sign of this is the attempt to suppress the expression of obvious truths, such as the fact that boys cannot become girls.

Another sign that many of our leaders consider us subjects is their denial of our right to decide who is allowed to enter our country--indeed, they tell us that if we complain about mass illegal immigration, we are racists.

**This is a pivotal time in our nation 's history--a time when we must stand up and forthrightly demand to be treated as citizens, not subjects. Because freedom hangs in the balance.**

A poisonous ideology has infected almost every major American institution. Only a few still stand in defense of freedom and the right of self-government.

One of the most important of these is **Hillsdale College**. And today, my friends at Hillsdale need your partnership and support in their mission to preserve the blessings of civil and religious liberty through education.

For 180 years, Hillsdale has offered its students the kind of education America's founders thought necessary to sustain free government. And in recent decades, Hillsdale has extended its teaching mission nationwide with a vast national outreach effort.

This outreach effort includes its free publication _Imprimis_ , its free online courses, and its tireless work to return excellence--including excellent civics instruction--to American K-12 education.

And Hillsdale College does all of this while refusing to accept one penny of government funding--not even indirectly through federal or state student grants and loans.

That's why I ask you to take the time to view their video **"[The Electoral College Explained](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=629bad775c9641b780ab80f7bdd26c7c&_e=83QhNU1-jIovkjPIBHhwWuMhRlWxKX7wYfNOYFnv_FiEyeAiafU6pBiYtN6G9Gl9CKCWrqj8bgYQm9ul46YmQubxJG5JSs75Li7mO3B91uvYCmXK1pQT7uWw6jqJ3-sZJLFgC-PeH_AD5eHue-8wWfVzO5Nb9fqSdCM2Wd0NWxtlcFuxgFmnfeUIlNrSU4yH87vE58iAKK043RwCGWAD3wSI3KhDMJ96XfJ2CWno6rKiCe1kx1OEWEZ3oaMCDEf2B5iZpXZb7nDVTc6qM_y0LEZFPL3jgvp0bsusv-7A1li1BCZHjgXKcMB05ay0n9pjZ3EQn8k_H7Xf4uRElNUrvtRI-w4ESCHZ5sjBC-3fQR95T1fyWGdv8TqzbFnTWcLI2TuNyw4JMFv46bcLdQGRVA%3D%3D)"** below and join Hillsdale in defending freedom and the American way of life.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1030 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1030]
Friends,
We are less than a week away from Election Day and have four days of early voting left. Here is how you can make a difference and help John Avlon win this race!
New York’s first district has more registered independent voters than almost any other district in the state. What does that mean to us? Your neighbors could still be undecided. That’s where you come in.
This race is coming down to the wire, and we’re going to need every last vote.
The best way to earn these votes is through conversations. That’s why I’m asking you to email or text 10 people you know in Suffolk County explaining why you’re casting a ballot for John and encouraging them to do the same. Here is what you can tell them:
John will stand up against hyperpartisanship: Congress has been plagued by hyperpartisanship and John has pledged to end it, drawing on the lessons of his books on George Washington and Abraham Lincoln. John is a commonsense Democrat who is focused on rebuilding the middle of our politics and the middle of our economy. He’s focused on a new kind of politics based on common facts and finding common ground for the common good. That's why he has been endorsed by Democrats, Independents, and Republicans. John will reach across the aisle and work with everyone to deliver results for Suffolk County and the entire country.
John will protect reproductive freedoms: John believes that the decision to have an abortion should be between a woman, her doctor, and her God – not the government. John’s opponent has said “overturning Roe v. Wade is a step in the right direction” and repeatedly that he would vote to stop second and third trimester abortions. That’s a 12 week abortion ban. Only John can be trusted on reproductive freedom.
John will fight for the middle class and tackle the affordability crisis: Since day one of his campaign, John has said that it is no coincidence that the middle of our politics has been hollowed out at the same time the middle of our economy has been hollowed out. John has pledged to restore the state and local tax deduction and fight for an enhanced child tax credit which will dramatically cut taxes for Long Islanders. John’s opponent has failed to make any progress on the state and local tax deduction and failed to get his own party to bring it up for a vote. We need real leadership in Congress fighting for Suffolk County. John has pledged that every economic question in Congress will be considered through the lens of whether it strengthens the middle class and restores faith in the American Dream.
John will protect our democracy: We must never have another act of political violence like we saw on January 6th, 2021. In the News12 debate, John called on his opponent to denounce Trump’s praise of Adolf Hitler and he couldn’t do it. How can we expect him to stand up to the extremists of his own party when he can’t even break with Trump on something so simple.
Many of you have already helped with your money and your time and we are asking once more to help us cross the finish line and take this race home for a win! Please reach out to ten friends or neighbors to make a difference in this race. And please vote early if you haven’t already, and be sure to encourage everyone you know to do the same because it helps us focus on voters who need the extra nudge.
Don’t forget to attach a photo and a link to John’s campaign site:

John's endorsements [https://www.johnavlon.com/endorsements]
Thanks for fighting the good fight with us. Now let’s make sure the fight is won.
-Bryan

subject: Do you know where your polling place is?
body:
Peter—are you going to bring your kids with you to vote? | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us8.campaign-archive.com/?e=7e921d898f&u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=b2d28e98a8)
---
| | | Hi Peter,
Being a parent is such a powerful responsibility. We model everything for our kids, from social behavior to hygiene habits. And perhaps most importantly, we model how to participate in society and make an impact in our communities.
That’s why it’s so important for our kids to see us voting and exercising our power to make positive change. Did you know that when parents participate in elections and teach kids about the importance of voting, kids are [more likely](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=f83c450567&e=7e921d898f) to vote when they grow up? One great way to model civic participation for your kids is to bring them with you to vote!
---
| |
[Find my polling place](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=893598649d&e=7e921d898f)
| You’re well on your way to making a difference in the lives of your kids and your community! And if you don’t have kids, you can still make a difference for future generations by forwarding this email to any parents you know! And, of course, by voting!
Thanks for doing your part to make voting a lifelong habit for our future leaders! 🙏🏾
---
| All the best,**Nani**

clean_body: Peter—are you going to bring your kids with you to vote? | | | | | | | | | Hi Peter, Being a parent is such a powerful responsibility. We model everything for our kids, from social behavior to hygiene habits. And perhaps most importantly, we model how to participate in society and make an impact in our communities. That’s why it’s so important for our kids to see us voting and exercising our power to make positive change. Did you know that when parents participate in elections and teach kids about the importance of voting, kids are to vote when they grow up? One great way to model civic participation for your kids is to bring them with you to vote! | | | You’re well on your way to making a difference in the lives of your kids and your community! And if you don’t have kids, you can still make a difference for future generations by forwarding this email to any parents you know! And, of course, by voting! Fellow patriot,

I’ve been crisscrossing the country to do everything I can to help the team get across the finish line this fall.

One of my most important stops: **_**campaigning in Ohio with Bernie Moreno.** _ **

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c6c66a13c28a45c48ab1e2b85f3b236e&_e=pIo6m1QG1MUiQ6HYRVgBFr-L9k1sqZjW8TZ9gxzeSJ2t70muShqWRww6GdRpwTHp74_m7lB-o6GtiavaK0JWOe2jB_kOcC5pfa6-avJJN3TkQxOc2poLgpLS2OCITSyKzvHtU7OIVNe7euOvPt0MmE8ryhLCd6VBqaV04WUFRwaJ1wO0-5l5bFx9JvBhpWkkGG8Cv_fdMB0HmkIBp0sip4vmSfNtLO86Glg7oBjGdtNlKQUCMTQNUlxM6HyBqLBJsFcYx-FD2o1BbByxy4SPTyjPK-izCo6ixBVxHkW5KWSBLIXmOLdr67QnnscJ3OaUe8f9lu2fqC9Bp8jiijcTeaIMW3p9oZ9EBWY-6B0IWIoepzhnK4TbJBSBoqbZgzRrXSPVGsegFKO3aTKDn1dmqg%3D%3D)

President Trump and a Senate Republican majority will end the disastrous Biden-Harris agenda, but we cannot win a Senate majority without winning in Ohio.

[**Will you join me in supporting political outsider, Bernie Moreno?**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c6c66a13c28a45c48ab1e2b85f3b236e&_e=pIo6m1QG1MUiQ6HYRVgBFr-L9k1sqZjW8TZ9gxzeSJ2t70muShqWRww6GdRpwTHp74_m7lB-o6GtiavaK0JWOe2jB_kOcC5pfa6-avJJN3TkQxOc2poLgpLS2OCITSyKzvHtU7OIVNe7euOvPt0MmE8ryhLCd6VBqaV04WUFRwaJ1wO0-5l5bFx9JvBhpWkkGG8Cv_fdMB0HmkIBp0sip4vmSfNtLO86Glg7oBjGdtNlKQUCMTQNUlxM6HyBqLBJKFlBwJkMq5t6_j1uITTXrwcnXag3z79UozYlSrhlo0CWr0hi7zCye2yvOROsbakwUGn-76OupvpfehaDz9vy7czgSQRaqzyWTS6CLSHI9F_5JVKW-v6s_DV5W4dGPc-_BxP7ILU1EerXkir2DlQr4Q%3D%3D)

Bernie Moreno is the type of Senator we need in Washington. He’s lived the American dream - and wants to make sure our grandkids have the same opportunities he had when he came to America at the age of five.

He hasn’t made a career as a Washington insider - just the opposite. He’s an entrepreneur who built a successful business from the ground up.

This November, we’ve got a great map—unlike anything we’ve seen in a few decades—and with high-quality candidates like Bernie, I know we can win back the Republican majority in the Senate.

But here’s the bad news, fellow patriot. _**Democrats like Sherrod Brown are outraising us by millions.**_

I’ve already transferred $4 million to help folks like Bernie, but he needs folks like you to step up to take on a 50-year career politician in Sherrod Brown.

[**Even just $10 can make a difference when it comes to the millions Sherrod Brown is raising from every liberal in the country.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c6c66a13c28a45c48ab1e2b85f3b236e&_e=pIo6m1QG1MUiQ6HYRVgBFr-L9k1sqZjW8TZ9gxzeSJ2t70muShqWRww6GdRpwTHp74_m7lB-o6GtiavaK0JWOe2jB_kOcC5pfa6-avJJN3TkQxOc2poLgpLS2OCITSyKzvHtU7OIVNe7euOvPt0MmE8ryhLCd6VBqaV04WUFRwaJ1wO0-5l5bFx9JvBhpWkkGG8Cv_fdMB0HmkIBp0sip4vmSfNtLO86Glg7oBjGdtNlKQUCMTQNUlxM6HyBqLBJr_sFhCgf4DHY-gfSTBMMXsVo8HSWIBQv4FRdGX9R28eGXnXMxiMVNb9n4-B-SvS6QMvvSFtaws90CvlFQzI3g5bGSkwQLAIdl12Dp0yJegDtB063w-qZL7uZbzRn_0voF7v9Z7rI6BqL-140sh7fLg%3D%3D)

Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

# Hate and Bigotry Is No Laughing Matter!

Dear Friend,
I hope this message finds you well. With less than six days remaining until the crucial election on November 5th, I feel compelled to address a deeply troubling incident involving comedian Tony Hinchcliffe, who recently made abhorrent, racist comments during a rally for Donald Trump. At this rally, Hinchcliffe attacked African Americans, Jewish Americans, Muslims Americans, Latino Americans and referred to Puerto Rico as a "floating island of garbage," a comment that not only perpetuates harmful stereotypes but also reflects a broader disdain for communities that have already faced significant challenges.
Furthermore, he made a shocking joke about Taylor Swift being assaulted and killed by her boyfriend, making light of domestic violence—a subject that is serious and should never be trivialized for entertainment. Such comments are not only deeply offensive but also perverse, and they have no place at a political rally. [_**See More Here.**_](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=ef5e3073e4&e=7b1b739a89)_****_
These remarks exemplify the toxic environment that we must actively reject. As we approach this pivotal election, it is essential that we unite against such vile rhetoric and demonstrate that we stand firmly against racism, sexism, and all forms of hate.[**I urge Pechanga Resort and the Tribal Council to take a stand by canceling Hinchcliffe’s scheduled show on December 6th. Allowing such hateful speech to continue unchecked only emboldens those who promote such intolerance.**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=71b93b0701&e=7b1b739a89)[**We must all take action. I encourage you to contact their corporate lobbyist Paula Treat at (916)-300-1151**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=3e84153f56&e=7b1b739a89)[**to voice your concerns and advocate for a cancellation.**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=84723ed4b6&e=7b1b739a89)
Let us use this election as an opportunity to reject hate and support candidates who champion inclusivity and respect for all individuals. Together, we can send a powerful message that our communities will not tolerate bigotry.
Thank you for your attention to this urgent matter.
Best regards,
Dr. Asif Mahmood

### **The Choice is Clear:
Competing Visions for MN03**
---
Observers have called this Congressional race “Minnesota Nice.” I appreciate the civil tone and focus on policy over the last few months.

**It’s important, however, the differences between me and my opponent, Kelly Morrison, are clear because there’s a lot at stake in this election.
**
My opponent and I are both running on our records. You don’t have to guess how you’ll be represented by either of us in Congress because we have prior public service you can review.

I’ve spent months sharing my experience as a judge, Hennepin County Commissioner, and legislator in both the MN House and Senate. I’ve talked about my accomplishments, like establishing our state-wide 9-1-1 system, creating the MN Court of Appeals so everyone had the right to an appeal, and my strong record on the environment.

My opponent, however, has been less candid about many aspects of her record. While she touts her record of working in a bipartisan fashion on a few issues, **when it comes to the things that matter most to people in the Third District, Morrison was a rubber stamp for her party.
**
There are three main areas, public safety, taxes and spending, and energy, where Morrison and her party failed to build consensus and ended up with solutions that were more partisan than practical. We’ve paid a high price for these highly political policies.

I’ve launched a webpage [https://www.tadjude.com/compare.html](http://email.mg.tadjude.com/c/eJxMj7Gu6yoQRb_GNBHRAAMDhYvT5DeeBmZI_GSfWDG5_v2rpLrl1trFWvyWRX-b_rfInKCQac_fwW18tmtQo2C0rZBazBotiybrKlOiStKbNzInChxBjM6OAgTvfYnmMQeXk6REXLISdxQuMUABBKEekppl9uDRQQAPoSBdIbZcS9ZYoUCXMCFs9-tg-f8tem3PzazzY4z9mMLP5G-Tv53n-S-f_K09t51fen2MbTWbHgffv23QtbWe0DqWZjEVsTm2aCE5djXXllsxz9f98_Upkw_cLEohiz2Cra5W65CpdE0eKJnXLPu5rOtyJJoQ7hsv69dxzD_reqnvcdlfehyXcxmPi36wGbrtK4-vUOhOIDmxVCRZFM2WQw2WKhBWdJgzmj-z_xsAAP__gkF8sA) where you can compare my opponent's record on these issues with my policies.

I hope you’ll visit this site, where you will see vastly different approaches to these important issues.

_While the issues are important, it is how we approach these issues which might be our greatest difference.
_
**There was no “One Minnesota” with Morrison in the MN Legislature. Rather, the last few years have been some of the most bitterly partisan years in the history of the MN Legislature.
**
Next week’s election might be the most consequential election of our lifetime, and we know our current hyper-partisan approach to lawmaking isn’t serving our nation well.

Things like the economy, immigration, and public safety require practical, nonpolitical solutions if we’re going to see real change. I’m running for Congress to find those solutions. I am committed to holding political parties, including my own, accountable when they get in the way of finding solutions for the people I represent.

I hope you will join me in putting practical solutions ahead of partisan politics. I will not let politics get in the way of doing what I believe is right for the Third District.

I hope I’ve earned your vote, and I thank you for your consideration and support.

clean_body: | | The Choice is Clear: Competing Visions for MN03 Observers have called this Congressional race “Minnesota Nice.” I appreciate the civil tone and focus on policy over the last few months. It’s important, however, the differences between me and my opponent, Kelly Morrison, are clear because there’s a lot at stake in this election. My opponent and I are both running on our records. You don’t have to guess how you’ll be represented by either of us in Congress because we have prior public service you can review. I’ve spent months sharing my experience as a judge, Hennepin County Commissioner, and legislator in both the MN House and Senate. I’ve talked about my accomplishments, like establishing our state-wide 9-1-1 system, creating the MN Court of Appeals so everyone had the right to an appeal, and my strong record on the environment. My opponent, however, has been less candid about many aspects of her record. While she touts her record of working in a bipartisan fashion on a few issues, when it comes to the things that matter most to people in the Third District, Morrison was a rubber stamp for her party. There are three main areas, public safety, taxes and spending, and energy, where Morrison and her party failed to build consensus and ended up with solutions that were more partisan than practical. We’ve paid a high price for these highly political policies. I’ve launched a webpage where you can compare my opponent's record on these issues with my policies. I hope you’ll visit this site, where you will see vastly different approaches to these important issues. While the issues are important, it is how we approach these issues which might be our greatest difference. There was no “One Minnesota” with Morrison in the MN Legislature. Rather, the last few years have been some of the most bitterly partisan years in the history of the MN Legislature. Next week’s election might be the most consequential election of our lifetime, and we know our current hyper-partisan approach to lawmaking isn’t serving our nation well. Things like the economy, immigration, and public safety require practical, nonpolitical solutions if we’re going to see real change. I’m running for Congress to find those solutions. I am committed to holding political parties, including my own, accountable when they get in the way of finding solutions for the people I represent. I hope you will join me in putting practical solutions ahead of partisan politics. I will not let politics get in the way of doing what I believe is right for the Third District. I hope I’ve earned your vote, and I thank you for your consideration and support. Learn More Here: | | Please visit and follow us on social media to get involved and gather more information on my campaign. | Thank you, Minnesota, for entrusting me with the opportunity to serve you. Sincerely, Paid for by Tad Jude for Congress PO Box 1881, Maple Grove, MN 55311 | To unsubscribe, click .

name: Derek Lyons - RITE
subject: RITE Scores Win in Montgomery County, PA, Securing Court Order to Post Notice of Voter Services Van Movements
body:
Great victory for transparency and equal access |
---
| |
---
| | **RITE Scores Win in Montgomery County, PA, Securing Court Order to Post Notice of Voter Services Van Movements** (Norristown, Pennsylvania – October 30, 2024) - Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (“RITE”), a non-profit organization which supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, today announced a significant victory in a case it [filed earlier this month against Montgomery County, Pennsylvania](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=7f3748b832&e=ea91f782ea) regarding its unlawful use of its voter services van. RITE was compelled to file this lawsuit after Montgomery County refused to do something very simple: Provide notice, 24-hours in advance, about the locations where the van would be conducting election-related services, including the distribution and acceptance of absentee ballots. The public has a right to this information, but for reasons known only to its officials, Montgomery County did not want to provide it. Today, the Montgomery County Court of Common Pleas put an end to these games. It has [ordered Montgomery County officials](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=a7d52a35d4&e=ea91f782ea)to post notices about the van’s operations at the county’s main office and at the location where the van will be. Absent exigent circumstances, this notice must be posted 24 hours in advance. This ruling will ensure that Montgomery County cannot conduct election operations out of the view of the public, enhancing trust in the process. This win is yet another reminder of the importance of conducting election operations, including voter registration operations, in full view of the public, particularly as other counties work to contain the [fallout from the submission of thousands of fraudulent voter registration applications](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=7012f9f4e4&e=ea91f782ea). “This is a great victory for transparency and equal access to election-related services under the law,” said Derek Lyons, President and CEO of RITE. “Montgomery County’s voter services van was the first of its kind, so it was important to establish that it be used properly to avoid sowing distrust in the election process among citizens. Conducting election operations beyond view of the public is exactly the kind of thing we should all strongly oppose.” ###

subject: “you’re garbage, Peter”
body:
Dear Peter,

Remember Joe Biden?

You know . . . the CURRENT President of the United States who couldn’t beat President Trump, so he got replaced by his cackling Vice President?

Well, he must still be furious about that because he just went on the record yesterday and EXPOSED how he truly feels about pro-lifers like you and me who might vote for President Trump.

“The only garbage I see floating out there is his supporters,” he said.

This is Hillary Clinton’s “basket of deplorables” comment all over again, BUT WORSE!

When a sitting President calls over HALF the country “garbage” simply because we won’t vote for his rabidly pro-abortion Vice President, our nation is in a dark place . . .

But Peter, don’t think for a second that we won’t get more of this kind of division and hatred from a Kamala Harris Presidency – she’s even worse.

Every chance she’s gotten, Kamala Harris has gone after pro-lifers, mocked and attacked Christians for our faith, and pushed a radical abortion-on-demand agenda even worse than Roe v. Wade – and she won’t stop short of destroying America to make it happen!

You and I have to stop her!

Students for Life Action is working tirelessly to EXPOSE just how radical she is to voters across the country through our critical Election Year Programs.

So, with the election less than a week away, the most impactful thing pro-lifers can do RIGHT NOW, is support our election efforts before it’s too late!

Will you please consider making your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 right away towards Students for Life Action’s Election Year Programs
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/L78dYWZxGQlBDBNwUOZkHA~~/AAVkMwA~~~
?

Even just chipping in $10 will help me create a “snowball” effect of grassroots pro-life support just in time for Election Day
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/py5xB9v8HUK-fk7dvDsP_Q~~/AAVkMwA~~~
!

Thank you for everything you do for Life, Peter.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

Opponents of voting rights at the Heritage Foundation have spent decades trying to undermine faith in our elections, cast fear over who is voting and how, and seed doubts in the minds of voters.
They want you afraid because they think that, when we're all scared and looking over our shoulders, we won't notice when our fundamental rights are taken away and the votes of those who oppose their movement suddenly don't count. We refuse to let them win.
RUSH $25 or more to educate voters about the safety of our elections, defend our right to vote, and make sure every vote counts this November and beyond! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=103024_3&amount=25]

WaPo: Trump allies at Heritage declare 2024 election illegitimate in advance [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=103024_3&amount=25]
This isn't a joke, Team. A dark money, inside the beltway think tank that has spent decades opposed to voting rights has already declared the election illegitimate.
News broke this morning that the ultra-conservative Heritage Foundation -- which has dumped millions into ballot restriction initiatives, vote-suppressing candidates, and spreading lies about mail-in ballots over the last few decades -- has already said there is " zero chance of a free and fair election " and has accused election officials, all the way up to the president, of creating an environment where the election cannot be certified.
Of course, they offered no proof to back up their accusations .
We've been saying it for a long time, but opponents of voting rights are ready to go to any length to ensure their fascistic, anti-democracy future comes to pass . They want their policies and ideas in place, regardless of how unpopular they are, and are willing to suppress however many votes they need in order to win.
We need everyone to step up and stop this vote-suppressing D.C. think-tank and their dark money millions before they alter our elections forever! Chip in with $25 or more to defend our elections and our right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=103024_3&amount=25]

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Our last chance to defeat this desperate, scared man
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
#

Team, Mark Kelly here.
What you’ve seen in the closing weeks of the campaign is a desperate, scared man.
A man who sucks up to dictators and dreams of becoming one himself.
A man who thinks Americans who made the ultimate sacrifice are suckers and losers.
A man who calls his political opponents on the other side of the aisle “the enemy within,” and thinks his own countrymen are a greater threat than those same foreign dictators he looks up to.
He is all of those things. But he is also a man with about a 50/50 chance of becoming the next President of the United States.
It’s up to us to do everything we can to move the needle in the right direction and make sure Trump, JD Vance, Kari Lake, and the entire MAGA Right are defeated — once and for all.
We can’t waste a single day between now and the election. We have less than a week to decide the future of our democracy, and the stakes are too high to do anything less than our greatest effort. Especially in a must-win state like Arizona.
I’ll be right here with you on the frontlines of this. But all of that is for nothing if I don’t have your support.
So, respectfully, I’m asking you to chip in.
[**Can you make a donation of $5 or $10 to support my work in Arizona? This is one of our last chances to make up ground and solidify our gains before we head into the election month, and your help would mean the world to me.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241030-1-120&t=1&akid=5912%2E6688874%2E3OtSUE)

Like millions of Americans, my life changed after 9/11.

I left my quiet life with my wife and kids to put my life on the line for our country, a sacrifice I'd still make today.

Before my first deployment to Afghanistan, my 10-year-old daughter asked me if I was going to get killed.

**Thanks be to God, I wasn't. **

My life of public service didn't end when I returned home.

During the COVID-19 Pandemic, my partners and I turned our whiskey distillery into a hand sanitizer production facility to deliver free hand sanitizer to families, first responders, and local hospitals in Montana.

As a small business owner, I was sick of dealing with government bureaucrats and their BS red tape. **So I took matters into my own hands and became Montana 's State Auditor. **

Running for office was never in the cards for me, but I hated seeing how our government was encroaching on every single inch of our lives. I protected Montanans from fraud, helped prosecute criminals, and fought to protect Montana's natural resources.

**But Democrats and Liberals are chomping at the bit to take control.** They have millions at their disposal to throw me under the bus, discredit me, and mock me. name: Tamie Wilson
subject: For my Mom, your sisters, and every woman: Let’s fight back
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month, and today, I’m reaching out from a very personal place.
My mother faced the terrifying reality of a breast cancer diagnosis while also grappling with barriers to healthcare access – barriers that put her life at risk.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241030_breast_cancer_awareness_month_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241030_breast_cancer_awareness_month_image]
Can you imagine the fear, not just from the diagnosis itself, but from the uncertainty of whether you can even get the care you need because politicians like Jim Jordan play partisan games with our healthcare?
It’s heartbreaking.
I’m fighting to expand healthcare access because I know what it means for families like mine. But I need your help to keep this campaign strong until Election Day. Can you rush a contribution of $25 or more to help elect a leader fighting to ensure every woman has access to the care they need? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241030_breast_cancer_awareness_month_link1]
Jim Jordan has spent years voting against healthcare protections.
He’s voted multiple times to kill the Affordable Care Act, which has helped save millions of lives.
He wants to defund women’s health service providers like Planned Parenthood, who are often one of the only resources countless women can turn to for early cancer detection and preventative screenings.
And now, with Project 2025, he’s supporting plans that would tear down Medicare instead of expanding it.
In Jim Jordan’s America, women are more likely to be sick, to suffer, and even to die – all because he refuses to put people over his extreme ULTRA-MAGA agenda.
This is why this election matters.
Because when it comes down to it, healthcare is about survival, dignity, and hope.
For me, for you, for all of us who’ve watched loved ones struggle with the double burden of illness and inadequate healthcare – let’s make sure no one else has to live in fear of choosing between their health and paying their bills.
With less than a week left, I’m asking you to help us finish strong. Every dollar counts in this fight to protect our families, our mothers, and our future.
Will you stand with me and chip in to finally fire Jim Jordan? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241030_breast_cancer_awareness_month_link2]
Thank you for being a part of this movement and for helping build a future where healthcare is a right, not a privilege. We’re in this together, every step of the way.
Let’s make history – for the survivors who are still with us, for the memory of those we’ve lost, and for the families who shouldn’t have to lose anyone to a system that refuses to care.
Together, let’s make Election Day a victory for every person who believes in a healthier, more compassionate future.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
PS: If you can join us making phone calls, knocking on doors, or a number of other things, please sign up ASAP here. [https://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer/]

I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges -- from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."

That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.

| Hi Team—

What if I told you that we’re just **6 days away from Election Day,** when the final votes will be cast and tallied in our critical Senate race?

Or what if I told you that **Californians are already casting their votes as we speak,** which means the time we have to convince undecided voters to support our movement is running out?

Friend,

**When this began, I promised Virginians we would take this case all the way to the U.S Supreme Court if necessary. Today, I am pleased to report the Court granted our request for an emergency stay**.

It's a big win for election integrity and the rule of law.

[**KEEP FIGHTING FOR ELECTION INTEGRITY**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=93f0aa9de2a849b2941daa46f72db26e&_e=NXPSLcGOeUkCgwkXs30SoKEc4RfB56cZUAtrYZvCBdXdpcO7abBCV8wpVxdz6eA0QmhJqLadVbolkDfYyGFLBnJ0AlaTQC2s9ClehjXZln2S2S7bLGFRkDLuPDlK8YGWoI96SuXwu01EJDp6I5GWGr3y-5un9jYt9f4r-fnOaM-QLulz88rnp1Ey31Se5MkwOqhA0TErVFJ520dQw9FjyU2KbQ3u_6mO2M0a6eH69YHUxovDR3rY0h5hYG26Z5iBiPtnB2QLEOm6xe2DbydZBmemthPaGjSMngpE_hFNV8AYYVMkzcOKyHCYdvCHvc6Kuj9F8HH7L7pik3jJMDRgAUODetUUW32Z8iuVsUqwNbwmCBjeGXxa0HxL3wUpI3A5ReNMkKilju3ljkWSY93Pw1fO16XTNlN7zt8UHcuK9Js%3D)
---
This ruling ensures that -- with less than a week before the elections -- Virginians can vote with confidence knowing Virginians will be choosing our elected officials. I am grateful that the Supreme Court recognized the importance of this issue and issued its decision in such a short time frame.

While I am gratified the Court moved so quickly, _I remain deeply concerned and alarmed that the Biden-Harris administration chose to execute this maneuver just 25 days before an election._
**Today 's ruling is a reaffirmation of our commitment to election integrity, and I look forward to ensuring that our electoral process remains secure for all Virginians.**

Defending our election security requires ongoing commitment.

body:
https://johncarney.org/ [https://johncarney.org/]

It's Time to Vote Delaware!

Dear Friend,

We are less than two weeks aware from the most consequential election of our lifetime. It is up to all of us to elect Delaware Democrats up and down the ballot. Make sure you have a plan and take a look at the most up-to-date information on how to make your voice heard.

VOTING RESOURCES

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/105967/images/calendar-660670_1920.jpg] Early voting continues through November 3rd. Make sure you have a plan to vote.
Polls are open
* 10/25 - 10/29: 11 AM - 7 PM
* 10/30 - 11/3: 7 AM - 7 PM

Confirm early voting locations here. [https://elections.delaware.gov/elections/votinglocations.shtml]

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/105967/images/Document.png]

Double check you are registered to vote and that your address is up to date.

Click here to verify your registration! [ivote.de.gov]

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/105967/images/istockphoto-593334194-612x612.jpg]

Turn out to vote on November 5th. Polls will be open from 7 AM to 7 PM.

Find your polling place here! [ivote.de.gov]

Make your plan to vote!

Vote for John Carney on November 5th or vote early!

You can vote at any early voting site [https://elections.delaware.gov/elections/votinglocations.shtml] in New Castle County on:

October 25, 2024 – October 29, 2024

11 a.m. – 7 p.m.

subject: Why I am heading to Ohio
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bernie Moreno for Senate
body:
Democrats like Sherrod Brown are outraising us by millions. |
---
Peter,

I’ve been crisscrossing the country to do everything I can to help the team get across the finish line this fall.

One of my most important stops: **_**campaigning in Ohio with Bernie Moreno.** _ **

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=12012cbc80ee4f139975c447e7993d34&_e=tWCYNZAr475RtFgKCODZWdamx0Pq9xKqKgl1iCtWcQM9CJkfDKA2eeuxo3ZH-3DTl7y0oftSSjpRMCpcVbVxCiUPgVerG6JdF92-o7_5P1b_byzTPYJ5qlh28JD5NANa7TwIHZvlhiS7-001TeVMJ_8VPJ5gUBl1gkq9_xfe0sOaEZrg358nG2cdc2UxtuZifMt9iLXhhGI0RJY5mexU5cPGK6KC6TZ83pixTPHkMsl6-x33ccpi3wZHLeQ-i3WaY5ggLJ90aD_oWCCUs29v4ReStDzAjFYJ8oAHAYQAssie0hQDY3LMcTF63BSdkOBHP0_LLfe7IxIVwhMA4C3JAPb9an-CyOl6Byw3bTYxQafO4Kr7UEXd9ZOA5fG_xdFr4BTAAQ_OhxMFAsyFMU-MsQ%3D%3D)

President Trump and a Senate Republican majority will end the disastrous Biden-Harris agenda, but we cannot win a Senate majority without winning in Ohio.

[**Will you join me in supporting political outsider, Bernie Moreno?**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=12012cbc80ee4f139975c447e7993d34&_e=tWCYNZAr475RtFgKCODZWdamx0Pq9xKqKgl1iCtWcQM9CJkfDKA2eeuxo3ZH-3DTl7y0oftSSjpRMCpcVbVxCiUPgVerG6JdF92-o7_5P1b_byzTPYJ5qlh28JD5NANa7TwIHZvlhiS7-001TeVMJ_8VPJ5gUBl1gkq9_xfe0sOaEZrg358nG2cdc2UxtuZifMt9iLXhhGI0RJY5mexU5cPGK6KC6TZ83pixTPHkMsl6-x33ccpi3wZHLeQ-i3WarbzN6NIrmjMlfDexUcTpbnQ1UA8g-LrU_sIhjcys2TGFf_STZIQUUSSEAZCc-Hn6Lid5oA_mablToWXP3O3mdrIobKpgAyq8OE8w9eut8MynxyR30vQ3FI9nxsluPbBBCeZt9EzqqwPNbIeYSUBY_g%3D%3D)

Bernie Moreno is the type of Senator we need in Washington. He’s lived the American dream - and wants to make sure our grandkids have the same opportunities he had when he came to America at the age of five.

He hasn’t made a career as a Washington insider - just the opposite. He’s an entrepreneur who built a successful business from the ground up.

This November, we’ve got a great map—unlike anything we’ve seen in a few decades—and with high-quality candidates like Bernie, I know we can win back the Republican majority in the Senate.

But here’s the bad news, Peter. _**Democrats like Sherrod Brown are outraising us by millions.**_

| | | Friend, it's Martin Sheen. There's somebody I want to tell you about.

He's a two-term governor running with Kamala Harris on the top of the ticket, a joyful warrior who eloquently and unapologetically represents Democratic values, and a loving father -- someone you can easily imagine lending you a hand around the house or, yes, even calling a hotline on Thanksgiving for turkey advice.

And no, I'm not talking about Jed Bartlet, my character on _The West Wing_. **I'm talking about Governor Tim Walz, our vice presidential nominee.** [**I know he and Vice President Harris will do a lot of good for our country, especially if folks like you and I do our part by pitching in $5 (matched to $20) to make sure they have a Democratic Senate majority to work with.**](https://go.dscc.org/go/20449?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20241030-MartinSheen-BartletWalzComparison-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20241030-MartinSheen-BartletWalzComparison-Pros-sl1&akid=18711%2E9716520%2EjZ-1Oq)

Why is your donation _today_ so important? Think about what we've accomplished together over the past four years: We've created millions of jobs, invested in American infrastructure, taken action on climate change, and so much more. **Our Democratic Senate majority has been a critical part of that progress.**

And after four years of digging out from Donald Trump's mistakes, we've all been reminded how important it is to have authenticity in the White House. President Biden has tirelessly worked to grow our middle class, and so has Vice President Harris. Based on his time leading Minnesota, I can tell you Governor Walz is cut from the same cloth.

**But building on our accomplishments requires electing genuine, hard-working leaders to more than just the White House.** It's also about having like-minded people in Congress who will push progress forward. Securing a Democratic Senate is absolutely crucial to continuing our work into 2025 and beyond.

**A Democratic Senate won't just appear out of thin air, though. We have to work for it. So, to help the Harris-Walz ticket make progress, I'm personally asking:**

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

AIPAC, self-described as “America’s pro-Israel lobby,” has paid for
hundreds of trips to Israel for members of Congress over the last decade
in order to influence U.S. foreign policy.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20241030?refcode=em20241030-36108&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36108_1203867_GwkHQw&akid=36108%2E1203867%2EGwkHQw ]Politico: Members of Congress have taken hundreds of AIPAC-funded trips
to Israel in the past decade

A new study highlighted by Politico shows that “Israel is far and away the
No. 1 destination for privately sponsored foreign travel by members of the
House and their aides,” largely thanks to AIPAC.

In 2024 so far, AIPAC paid for eight trips by 71 House members and
staffers from March through early September; in total, the right-wing
megadonor-funded group covered about 75% of all congressional trips to
Israel.

U.S. leaders have taken more trips to Israel than to the entire Western
Hemisphere and the continent of Africa combined.

These trips are designed to give U.S. lawmakers a one-sided view of the
conflict between Israel and Palestine and influence foreign policy
decisions like additional funding for Israel’s military.

This is yet another way that AIPAC exerts its power and influence over our
political system, maintaining billions of dollars in weapons and bombs
from the U.S. despite the majority of voters’ desire for an arms embargo
and ceasefire in Gaza.

name: Ryan Mackenzie
subject: Susan Wild Sinks to New Low
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mackenzie For Congress]()
body:
We can never ignore our veterans or their families | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | | | Friend,
We’ve seen a lot of reminders in this campaign of just how out-of-touch Susan Wild is with the people of the Lehigh Valley. During her time in Congress, she’s insulted her constituents, intentionally misled people about her positions, denigrated a veteran on Facebook, and illegally parked in handicapped spots.
**But what we’ve recently learned is a new low.**
During this campaign, I had the honor to meet Michael and Sarah Wargo, gold star parents who lost their son to PTSD. Since their son’s passing, they have done inspiring work in our community to raise awareness of veteran suicide. As part of their work, they’ve met with elected officials all across PA and throughout the country.
Unfortunately, Susan Wild, their own congresswoman, won’t answer their calls.
Listen to them tell their [story](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=84c073bca2&e=5ccada9200).
---
[](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=efcc4154ab&e=5ccada9200)
| If you’re like me, you know that we owe everything to the men and women who have served and sacrificed for our country. It’s outrageous that families like the Wargos aren’t getting the support they need from their representative in Congress. That’s why I’m asking you to do one simple thing: can you please help us share their story? It’s time for the people of the Lehigh Valley to learn the truth about the stakes in this election.

Right now, the Left is working around the clock to undermine the Supreme Court's decision while mobilizing millions of pro-choice democrats and major media outlets to codify on-demand abortion at taxpayers' expense. Judicial Watch announced recently that the U.S. Court of Appeals
for the Fifth Circuit has issued an opinion reversing a lower court
ruling on Mississippi’s election law that permitted absentee ballots
to be received as late as five business days after Election Day.

Earlier this year, Judicial Watch filed the civil
rights lawsuit challenging the Mississippi election law on behalf of
the Libertarian Party of Mississippi (Libertarian Party of
Mississippi v Wetzel et al. (No. 1:24-cv-00037)). The court
consolidated the case filed by Judicial Watch with one filed by the
Republican National Committee, the Mississippi Republican Party, and
other complainants.

To ensure that our message reaches every corner of our district, we’re launching a strategic advertising campaign that will place our vision front and center for all to see. subject: What President Trump told me.

body:
**Peter,** Last night, President Trump hosted a telephone town hall on my behalf. Beforehand, we had a chance to chat, and I want to share what he told me: He said _we have to win_ because, without control of the U.S. House, his plans to secure the border, revive the economy, and end foolish foreign engagements will be _dead in the water._ With just days left, our pathway to victory is narrowing: my opponent has raised over **$10 million** and has another **$15 million** in special interest spending backing her up. Will you help me overcome this disadvantage so I can support President Trump in advancing his agenda by contributing whatever you can today at [JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Bqr2jPTz3epdLI3RXFML4g/8WW9O3uLRwflGg5Q1WAKKw)? Just imagine what President Trump would face from a Congress controlled by Democrats like my opponent, Marie Perez:
* Phony impeachment trials.
* Investigations that distract and drain resources from the executive branch.
* A complete blockade of all legislation President Trump needs to reverse the damage done during the Biden-Harris administration.

I can't stress this enough: _If Republicans don 't flip my seat, holding the U.S. House will be nearly impossible._ I urge you to give whatever you can afford--before it's too late--at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/e7JNL5Yay1bhAh7Q4z98YA/8WW9O3uLRwflGg5Q1WAKKw). We need to raise $200,000 in the next two days to keep our ads on the air through the final weekend; otherwise, we will go dark. Thank you for all you've done, and please give what you can spare. Respectfully, **Joe Kent** [](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/rvokoLmraCtJng0DYe440Q/8WW9O3uLRwflGg5Q1WAKKw) _Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund_

**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Fellow patriot,

I’ve been crisscrossing the country to do everything I can to help the team get across the finish line this fall.

One of my most important stops: **_**campaigning in Ohio with Bernie Moreno.** _ **

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b8f9c254f62742f59235e6069a7945d1&_e=4Po-2oBqMV9IK1azIIv4YbB5KgVyWmjv9qpLPtfzS-9XaGx0UdDoW5JdFIqziNu3J5ntq0CrJ_N391lAwWb2HQiYSuvAc6pmN9yXaLiaq3CNHLxu5266Ac5h6VjhQwhTjkUbWmpj6GNZNRf7Yw1Kqbs-WNMufnPBoigNST1BTGVPA0yg7_tbd4NnjQr0L8dXQDiKiDOYYmm7cIa2_gz58BBJrp3No1d-xOd2XEFtMSMWtu14EYWD5xqLXP1gXwctvW-1wUHDVb4qCoeFgmdwbfSAVB42gJTq2_hXvGXPWq_nEF8exu6Ahp-UG01hZEEpZP7fjZTeHr6Zp5nhDqZiOUJQBjo9hP-Z1jZ5ccIRSP5kyKkCsjMy1ucyp2RDR-GPRg-MjMFHdwfrtt5KwKrYgQ%3D%3D)

President Trump and a Senate Republican majority will end the disastrous Biden-Harris agenda, but we cannot win a Senate majority without winning in Ohio.

[**Will you join me in supporting political outsider, Bernie Moreno?**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b8f9c254f62742f59235e6069a7945d1&_e=4Po-2oBqMV9IK1azIIv4YbB5KgVyWmjv9qpLPtfzS-9XaGx0UdDoW5JdFIqziNu3J5ntq0CrJ_N391lAwWb2HQiYSuvAc6pmN9yXaLiaq3CNHLxu5266Ac5h6VjhQwhTjkUbWmpj6GNZNRf7Yw1Kqbs-WNMufnPBoigNST1BTGVPA0yg7_tbd4NnjQr0L8dXQDiKiDOYYmm7cIa2_gz58BBJrp3No1d-xOd2XEFtMSMWtu14EYWD5xqLXP1gXwctKpKJi7GqynKrZS947BdoCLRzJRvNtSz-_8T5qWtTQsD99t5VFuS2k85yvT_Jt5ZnhLQ-2rBQ-1O4UQkUkU9m70TTrUDvAt9F282D_UJgRFCCbC_ZDflvGVncz9VXyDBWONJ-gv7XnFEPTTarKvGbFQ%3D%3D)

Bernie Moreno is the type of Senator we need in Washington. He’s lived the American dream - and wants to make sure our grandkids have the same opportunities he had when he came to America at the age of five.

He hasn’t made a career as a Washington insider - just the opposite. He’s an entrepreneur who built a successful business from the ground up.

This November, we’ve got a great map—unlike anything we’ve seen in a few decades—and with high-quality candidates like Bernie, I know we can win back the Republican majority in the Senate.

But here’s the bad news, fellow patriot. _**Democrats like Sherrod Brown are outraising us by millions.**_

Nevada was _always_ going to be one of the closest and most expensive states in the country – especially after Republicans came just 0.77% away from winning Nevada’s last Senate election in 2022. **But ever since Donald Trump singled out Jacky’s race during his speech at the Republican National Convention, a shocking amount of outside money has flooded into Nevada to prop up Jacky’s MAGA opponent, Sam Brown.**
I know Jacky, and I know that she is rolling up her sleeves and getting to work every single day so she can defeat her extreme opponent and continue delivering progress for hardworking Nevadans. But no one can fend off the full force of the MAGA fundraising operation on their own – and Jacky is counting on us to step up and help her out before it’s too late.

My friend Kirsten is running for one of the most flippable House seats in the country right here in Southern Arizona.
This race is special — and I’m doing everything I can to help. Every bit of grassroots support will make a difference, so if you can, please, consider donating before her October fundraising deadline tomorrow. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_103024_EOM_L_Kelly_act]

She’s an educator who spent years working to fund our public schools and will do the same in Congress.
