| | Dear Peter, In Des Moines, kids trick-or-treat the night before Halloween on what we call “Beggars Night,” a tradition that Caitlin Clark talked about recently in an [interview.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96192308/509195800/1744586?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkyOTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTIyNDU4OTMtMTE5Ny1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=dC5NS61T3-m9HWDWCdkaTy4qs8r5WGazMlNBUXtXkRs=&emci=04e48e69-2996-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=92245893-1197-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=23786099) Freya and I have our own tradition every year: planning what we’ll build for her costume. It’s fun to encourage Freya’s love of art, challenge her creativity, and incorporate engineering principles into the costume design. A few years ago, we built “Block E,” a robot that lit up, made sounds, and had a candy chute (her favorite part). **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96192309/509195801/2052668743?&refcode=E11336-20241030-BeggarsNight-Image-Holiday&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkyOTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTIyNDU4OTMtMTE5Ny1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=dC5NS61T3-m9HWDWCdkaTy4qs8r5WGazMlNBUXtXkRs=)**_Freya and Sydney on Beggars Night 2022._ This year, Freya wanted to be an ice cream cone since her Auntie started her own ice cream business this spring. Freya came up with the idea, sketched out a design, and we engineered it together. What do you think of her costumes? [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96192310/509195802/2052668743?&refcode=E11336-20241030-BeggarsNight-Image-Holiday&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkyOTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTIyNDU4OTMtMTE5Ny1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=dC5NS61T3-m9HWDWCdkaTy4qs8r5WGazMlNBUXtXkRs=) _ Sydney, Freya, and Lanon at a costume party, October 2024._ I’ve always tried to instill in Freya that we can do big things as long as we try. It starts with an idea, but that idea needs a plan to result in success. Most importantly, success requires commitment and follow through. There’s no doubt that I will take this same approach when serving our state and community in Congress. Whatever your plans are for Halloween (or Beggars Night), get your costumes ready. We hope you have a fun and safe day! Your friend, Lanon

IT’S NOW OR NEVER
I Will Clean Out the Rot in D.C.–
Stand with Me!
Dear Peter,
With only **SIX DAYS** left until Election Day, the stakes couldn’t be higher. Across the political spectrum, there’s one thing everyone agrees on: **America is at a turning point.**
Consider this: a recent Gallup poll showed **68%** of Americans have little or no trust in the media. And the distrust in Congress? It’s just as bad.
[**This lack of faith in our institutions is something we can’t ignore.**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-turning?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=turning_point_10_30_24_1&n=5)
Here’s what I’m fighting for:
1. **Clean out the rot in DC** – removing corporate influence from our government agencies so they finally serve the American people.
2. **End the propaganda and censorship regime** – because a nation that silences truth cannot stand strong.

With President Trump’s support, I know we can make it happen. I’ve spent 40 years suing corrupt agencies and corporations – I know how they work, and I know how to clean them up.
But this isn’t a one-man fight. We need everyone’s voice, and right now, you can help in two critical ways:
First, **make your voice heard by voting** – a ballot for Donald Trump is a vote to end the forever wars, protect freedom of speech, get corruption out of our government agencies, and reverse the chronic disease epidemic.
Second, [**stand with us financially**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-turning?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=turning_point_10_30_24_1&n=6). Every single dollar counts in this fight. Go to [Mahanow.org](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-turning?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=turning_point_10_30_24_1&n=7) and make a contribution. Together, we can show the strength of our movement and what we stand for.
[Urgent: Donate Now](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-turning?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=turning_point_10_30_24_1&n=8)
This is it – our moment to take America down a new path. We’re in the final stretch – let’s cross that finish line together.

| | Peter,
The Rocky Mountain Voice is letting freedom ring in the Centennial State by building trust through truth.
We are an unapologetically pro-citizen, pro-liberty, and pro-Colorado organization. Our mission is to provide a news source untainted by the left-wing agenda and pervasive liberal bias. These practices were once commonplace in journalism, but, unfortunately, they have all but been abandoned by legacy media and even many local news outlets.
In these crucial days leading up to November 5, RMV is reporting the news that the
establishment media companies won’t because **Coloradans deserve to know the real story** —from Washington, D.C., to right here in the Rockies.
Though these big news conglomerates keep trying to paint some candidates as joyful moderates, RMV will continue to tell the truth about the real records —or lack thereof— of people seeking to make our laws and govern our land. Voters must discover the truth about the candidates, their policies, and their voting records.
Through our daily news update in the Rocky Mountain Minute and the wide array of stories found on our website, podcasts, and videos, RMV arms Coloradans with the facts so they can decide whether to send politicians packing.
Peter, with [your support](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), we can continue to spread the truth all over our state. Will you help us carry on this mission of providing real news to our citizens?
